        '<div class="nr-title">' + (ttlMark || esc(ttl)) + "</div>" +
        (dup ? "" : '<div class="nr-prev">' + (pvMark || esc(pv)) + "</div>") +
        '<div class="nr-top nr-foot" style="margin:8px 0 0"><span class="nr-ntype">' + icon(NTYPE_ICON[nType(n)], 11) + NTYPE_LABEL[nType(n)] + "</span>" +
        hitBadge +
        '<span class="spacer"></span><span class="nr-doc" title="' + esc(docTitle(n.docId)) + '">' + esc(docTitle(n.docId)) + "</span></div>" +
        "</div>";
    }).join("");
    qsa("#notesList .note-row").forEach(function (r) {
      r.addEventListener("click", function () { openNote(r.dataset.note); });
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     载入 / 视图切换
     ============================================================ */
  function openNote(id) {
    var n = state.notes.find(function (x) { return x.id === id; });
    if (!n) return;
    state.curId = id;
    qs("#titleInput").value = n.title || "";
    qs("#srcChip").style.display = "inline-flex";
    qs("#srcChip").innerHTML = icon("book-marked", 12) + '<span class="wb-src-t">' + esc(docTitle(n.docId)) + " · P" + (n.page || 1) + "</span>";
    qs("#gotoSrc").style.display = EMBED ? "none" : "inline-flex";
    qs("#gotoSrc").href = srcLink(n.docId, n.id);
    qs("#gotoSrc").innerHTML = icon("arrow-up-right", 12) + "回到原文";
    qs("#btnDel").disabled = false;

    if (migrateNote(n)) InkStore.upsertNote(n);

    state.tree = (n.outline || []).map(normRow);
    state.olFocus = 0; state.olSel = null;
    state.mind = n.mind ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(n.mind)) : null;
    state.mmSel = state.mind ? state.mind.root : null;
    qs("#mmEdit").value = state.mmSel ? (mindNode(state.mmSel) || {}).text || "" : "";

    var v = (n.ntype === "mindmap" || n.ntype === "md" || n.ntype === "outline") ? n.ntype : "outline";
    setView(v);
    renderList();
    setDirty(false);
  }

  function flushMd() {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    if (ta) state.tree = parse(ta.value);
  }

  function setView(v) {
    if (state.view === "md" && v !== "md") flushMd();
    state.view = v;
    qsa("#viewTabs .ntype-tab").forEach(function (t) {
      var on = t.dataset.view === v;
      t.classList.toggle("active", on);
      t.setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
    });
    qsa(".npane").forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle("on", p.dataset.view === v); });

    if (v === "outline") renderOutline();
    else if (v === "mindmap") {
      var relaid = syncMind();
      if (relaid) fitMind();
      renderMind();
    } else {
      qs("#mdEditor").value = serialize(state.tree);
      syncPreview();
    }
    updateViewSwap();
    updateHint();
  }

  /* 大纲 ⇄ 脑图 一键切换（幕布调研项）：只切当前视图，存储类型 ntype 不变 */
  function updateViewSwap() {
    var b = qs("#btnViewSwap"); if (!b) return;
    if (state.view === "md") { b.style.display = "none"; return; }
    b.style.display = "inline-flex";
    var toMind = state.view === "outline";
    b.title = toMind ? "一键切换到思维导图" : "返回大纲视图";
    b.setAttribute("aria-label", b.title);
    qs("#btnViewSwapLabel").textContent = toMind ? "导图视图" : "返回大纲";
    qs("#icViewSwap").innerHTML = icon(toMind ? "network" : "list-tree", 14);
  }
  qs("#btnViewSwap").addEventListener("click", function () {
    setView(state.view === "mindmap" ? "outline" : "mindmap");
  });

  qsa("#viewTabs .ntype-tab").forEach(function (t) {
    t.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (t.dataset.view === state.view) return;
      setView(t.dataset.view);
      if (state.view === "outline" && !state.tree.length) {
        state.tree = [newNode(0, "")];
        renderOutline();
        setTimeout(function () { focusRow(0, false); }, 20);
      }
    });
  });

  function updateHint() {
    var t = qs("#titleInput").value.trim() || "未命名笔记";
    var n = state.tree.filter(function (r) { return (r.text || "").trim(); }).length;
    var hot = state.tree.filter(function (r) { return (r.pri | 0) >= 2; }).length;
    qs("#editorHint").textContent = t + " · 条目 " + n + (hot ? " · 高优先 " + hot : "") + " · 当前视图 " + VSHORT[state.view];
    immMeta(); immTabs();
  }
  qs("#titleInput").addEventListener("input", function () {
    updateHint();
    if (state.mind) { var r = mindNode(state.mind.root); if (r) { r.text = titleText(); renderMind(); } }
  });

  /* ============================================================
     一、文字大纲
     ============================================================ */
  function autoGrow(ta) { ta.style.height = "auto"; ta.style.height = Math.max(26, ta.scrollHeight) + "px"; }

  function renderOutline() {
    var wrap = qs("#olList");
    if (!state.tree.length) {
      wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="ol-empty">按工具栏「新增」起第一条，或用 Enter 连续分点</div>';
      return;
    }
    var html = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < state.tree.length; i++) {
      var r = state.tree[i];
      if (isHidden(i)) continue;
      var hasKids = (i + 1 < state.tree.length && state.tree[i + 1].lv > r.lv);
      var pri = r.pri | 0;
      var nHide = (hasKids && r.folded) ? blockEnd(i) - i - 1 : 0;   /* 折叠时被藏住的后代数 */
      html += '<div class="ol-row' + (r.done ? " done" : "") + (r.id === state.olSel ? " on" : "") + (pri >= 2 ? " hot" : "") +
        '" data-i="' + i + '" data-lv="' + r.lv + '" data-pri="' + pri + '">' +
        '<button class="ol-caret' + (hasKids ? "" : " leaf") + (r.folded ? " folded" : "") + '" data-act="fold" tabindex="-1" aria-label="折叠">' + icon("chevron-down", 13) + "</button>" +
        '<button class="ol-pri" data-act="pri" tabindex="-1" title="优先级：点击循环（○ / ! / !! / !!!）" aria-label="优先级">' + PRI_MARK[pri] + "</button>" +
        '<span class="ol-dot"></span>' +
        '<textarea class="ol-input" rows="1" data-i="' + i + '" placeholder="' + (r.lv === 0 ? "一级要点" : "子要点") + '">' + esc(r.text) + "</textarea>" +
        '<button class="ol-tag' + (r.tag ? " on" : "") + '" data-act="tag" tabindex="-1" title="分类标签" aria-label="分类标签">' +
        (r.tag ? "#" + esc(r.tag) : icon("tag", 12)) + "</button>" +
        (nHide ? '<button class="ol-foldn" data-act="fold" tabindex="-1" title="展开 ' + nHide + ' 条子级" aria-label="展开子级">+' + nHide + "</button>" : "") +
        '<button class="ol-check" data-act="check" tabindex="-1" aria-label="标记完成">' + icon("check", 11) + "</button>" +
        '<span class="ol-grip">' + icon("grip-vertical", 14) + "</span>" +
        "</div>";
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    qsa(".ol-input", wrap).forEach(autoGrow);
  }

  function focusRow(i, toEnd) {
    var ta = qs('.ol-input[data-i="' + i + '"]', qs("#olList"));
    if (!ta) return;
    ta.focus();
    var len = ta.value.length;
    ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = toEnd === false ? 0 : len;
  }

  function moveBlock(i, dir) {
    var lv = state.tree[i].lv, end = blockEnd(i);
    var block = state.tree.slice(i, end);
    if (dir < 0) {
      var p = i - 1;
      if (p < 0 || state.tree[p].lv !== lv) return;
      var prevBlock = state.tree.slice(p, i);
      state.tree.splice.apply(state.tree, [p, end - p].concat(prevBlock, block));
      state.olFocus = p;
    } else {
      if (end >= state.tree.length || state.tree[end].lv !== lv) return;
      var nNext = blockEnd(end), nextBlock = state.tree.slice(end, nNext);
      state.tree.splice.apply(state.tree, [i, nNext - i].concat(nextBlock, block));
      state.olFocus = i + nextBlock.length;
    }
    renderOutline(); focusRow(state.olFocus, true); updateHint();
  }

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input"); if (!ta) return;
    state.tree[+ta.dataset.i].text = ta.value;
    autoGrow(ta);
    updateHint();
  });

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("focusin", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input"); if (!ta) return;
    state.olFocus = +ta.dataset.i;
    state.olSel = state.tree[state.olFocus] ? state.tree[state.olFocus].id : null;
    qsa("#olList .ol-row").forEach(function (row) { row.classList.remove("on"); });
    var row = ta.closest(".ol-row");
    if (row) row.classList.add("on");
  });

  /* 幕布式条目键盘：Enter 拆行（光标后文字跟新行，有子级时落在整块之后）、
     Tab / Shift+Tab 整块缩进反缩进、方向键微调层级、空行 Backspace 删除 */
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input"); if (!ta) return;
    var i = +ta.dataset.i, r = state.tree[i];
    if (!r) return;
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var head = ta.value.slice(0, ta.selectionStart);
      var tail = ta.value.slice(ta.selectionEnd);
      r.text = head;
      var at = blockEnd(i);   /* 当前行有子级时新行插到整块之后，避免抢占子级 */
      state.tree.splice(at, 0, newNode(r.lv, tail));
      state.olFocus = at;
      setDirty(true);
      renderOutline(); focusRow(at, false); updateHint();
    } else if (e.key === "Tab") {
      e.preventDefault();
      var ok = e.shiftKey ? outdentRow(i) : indentRow(i);   /* 缩进不超上一行+1，反缩进下限 0 */
      if (ok) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
    } else if (e.key === "Backspace" && !ta.value) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (state.tree.length > 1) {
        state.tree.splice(i, 1);
        state.olFocus = Math.max(0, i - 1);
        setDirty(true);
        renderOutline(); focusRow(state.olFocus, true);
      }
      updateHint();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp" && i > 0) {
      e.preventDefault(); state.olFocus = i - 1; focusRow(i - 1, true);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown" && i < state.tree.length - 1) {
      e.preventDefault(); state.olFocus = i + 1; focusRow(i + 1, true);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && ta.selectionStart === 0 && ta.selectionEnd === 0) {
      e.preventDefault(); if (outdentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, false); updateHint(); }
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && ta.selectionStart === ta.value.length && ta.selectionEnd === ta.value.length) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (indentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
    }
  });

  /* 行内标签编辑：点行尾 chip → 就地输入 */
  function editTag(i, btn) {
    var inp = document.createElement("input");
    inp.className = "ol-tag-in";
    inp.value = state.tree[i].tag || "";
    inp.placeholder = "分类";
    inp.setAttribute("aria-label", "分类标签");
    btn.replaceWith(inp);
    inp.focus(); inp.select();
    var done = false;
    function commit(save) {
      if (done) return; done = true;
      if (save) state.tree[i].tag = inp.value.trim().replace(/^#/, "").slice(0, 12);
      renderOutline(); updateHint();
    }
    inp.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); commit(true); }
      else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); commit(false); }
    });
    inp.addEventListener("blur", function () { commit(true); });
  }

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var act = e.target.closest("[data-act]"); if (!act) return;
    var row = act.closest(".ol-row"); if (!row) return;
    var i = +row.dataset.i;
    var a = act.dataset.act;
    if (a === "fold") { state.tree[i].folded = !state.tree[i].folded; renderOutline(); }
    else if (a === "check") { state.tree[i].done = !state.tree[i].done; renderOutline(); updateHint(); }
    else if (a === "pri") { state.tree[i].pri = ((state.tree[i].pri | 0) + 1) % 4; renderOutline(); updateHint(); }
    else if (a === "tag") { editTag(i, act); }
  });

  qs("#olIndent").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var i = state.olFocus;
    if (indentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
  });
  qs("#olOutdent").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var i = state.olFocus;
    if (outdentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
  });
  qs("#olUp").addEventListener("click", function () { moveBlock(state.olFocus, -1); });
  qs("#olDown").addEventListener("click", function () { moveBlock(state.olFocus, 1); });
  qs("#olAdd").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var i = state.olFocus, r = state.tree[i];
    var at = r ? i + 1 : 0;
    state.tree.splice(at, 0, newNode(r ? r.lv : 0, ""));
    state.olFocus = at;
    renderOutline(); focusRow(at, false); updateHint();
  });

  /* ---------- 拖右侧手柄排序：整块（含子级）落到目标行 ---------- */
  var olDrag = null;
  function indexOfRowId(id) {
    for (var i = 0; i < state.tree.length; i++) if (state.tree[i].id === id) return i;
    return -1;
  }
  function dropIndexAt(clientY) {
    var rows = qsa("#olList .ol-row");
    if (!rows.length) return 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var r = rows[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      if (clientY < r.top + r.height / 2) return +rows[i].dataset.i;
    }
    return blockEnd(+rows[rows.length - 1].dataset.i);
  }
  function moveBlockTo(from, to) {
    var lv = state.tree[from].lv, end = blockEnd(from);
    var block = state.tree.slice(from, end);
    var rest = state.tree.slice(0, from).concat(state.tree.slice(end));
    var t = to > from ? to - block.length : to;
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(rest.length, t));
    state.tree = rest.slice(0, t).concat(block, rest.slice(t));
    /* 层级合法化：新位置上一行即「新父行」，块根不得深过 父行+1（拖到顶视为父行 -1 级）；
       深了就整块统一上提（负向平移），块内相对层级不变，后代一并夹回合法范围 */
    var prev = t > 0 ? state.tree[t - 1] : null;
    var pl = prev ? prev.lv : -1;
    if (pl < lv) {
      var d = Math.min(4, pl + 1) - lv;
      for (var k = t; k < t + block.length; k++) state.tree[k].lv = Math.max(0, state.tree[k].lv + d);
    }
    state.olFocus = t;
  }
  /* 拖拽指示线：标到目标行上缘；落到列表末尾时标在最后一行下缘（.drop-end） */
  function markDropLine(to) {
    qsa("#olList .ol-row").forEach(function (r) { r.classList.remove("drop-line", "drop-end"); });
    if (to < 0) return;
    var el = qs('#olList .ol-row[data-i="' + to + '"]');
    if (el) { el.classList.add("drop-line"); return; }
    var rows = qsa("#olList .ol-row");
    if (rows.length) rows[rows.length - 1].classList.add("drop-line", "drop-end");
  }

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    var grip = e.target.closest(".ol-grip");
    if (!grip) return;
    var row = grip.closest(".ol-row");
    if (!row) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    olDrag = { id: state.tree[+row.dataset.i].id, moved: false };
    qs("#olList").classList.add("dragging");
    if (qs("#olList").setPointerCapture) qs("#olList").setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    if (!olDrag) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var from = indexOfRowId(olDrag.id);
    if (from < 0) return;
    var to = dropIndexAt(e.clientY), end = blockEnd(from);
    if (to > from && to < end) { markDropLine(-1); return; }   /* 落在自己块内：无意义 */
    if (to !== from && to !== end) {
      moveBlockTo(from, to);
      renderOutline();
      var row = qs('#olList .ol-row[data-i="' + state.olFocus + '"]');
      if (row) row.classList.add("dragging");
      olDrag.moved = true;
      markDropLine(dropIndexAt(e.clientY));   /* 移动后行号已变，按当前布局重算指示位置 */
      updateHint();
    } else {
      markDropLine(to);
    }
  });

  function endOlDrag() {
    if (!olDrag) return;
    var moved = olDrag.moved;
    olDrag = null;
    qs("#olList").classList.remove("dragging");
    state.olSel = state.tree[state.olFocus] ? state.tree[state.olFocus].id : null;
    renderOutline();
    if (moved) setDirty(true);   /* 拖拽改了结构，走既有 2.5s 自动保存链路 */
  }
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointerup", endOlDrag);
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointercancel", endOlDrag);

  /* ============================================================
     二、思维导图（同一棵树的图形视图）
     ============================================================ */
  function nodeBox(n) {
    var w = Math.max(78, String(n.text || "").length * 13 + 26);
    return { w: w, h: 30 };
  }
  function mmToWorld(cx, cy) {
    var r = qs("#mmStage").getBoundingClientRect(), v = state.mmView;
    return { x: (cx - r.left - v.x) / v.k, y: (cy - r.top - v.y) / v.k };
  }

  /* 由树自动布局出一张脑图；root 的文案取笔记标题 */
  function mindFromTree(rows, rootText) {
    var nodes = [{ id: "m0", text: rootText || "中心主题", x: 0, y: 0, parent: null }];
    var stack = [{ lv: -1, id: "m0" }], depth = { m0: 0 }, seq = 1;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      while (stack.length > 1 && stack[stack.length - 1].lv >= r.lv) stack.pop();
      var parent = stack[stack.length - 1].id;
      var id = "m" + (seq++);
      nodes.push({ id: id, text: (r.text || "").trim() || "…", x: 0, y: 0, parent: parent });
      depth[id] = depth[parent] + 1;
      stack.push({ lv: r.lv, id: id });
    });
    var kids = {};
    nodes.forEach(function (n) { (kids[n.parent] = kids[n.parent] || []).push(n.id); });
    var cursor = 0, y = {};
    function walk(id) {
      var ch = kids[id] || [];
      if (!ch.length) { y[id] = cursor; cursor += 62; return y[id]; }
      var ys = ch.map(walk);
      y[id] = (ys[0] + ys[ys.length - 1]) / 2;
      return y[id];
    }
    walk("m0");
    nodes.forEach(function (n) { n.x = depth[n.id] * 208; n.y = y[n.id]; });
    return { root: "m0", nodes: nodes };
  }

  /* 脑图节点的文档序（数组插入序 = 树序，拖动只改坐标不改序） */
  function mindOrder(mind) {
    if (!mind || !mind.nodes || !mind.nodes.length) return [];
    var kids = {};
    mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { (kids[n.parent] = kids[n.parent] || []).push(n); });
    var out = [];
    (function walk(id) {
      (kids[id] || []).forEach(function (c) { out.push(c.id); walk(c.id); });
    })(mind.root);
    return out;
  }
  function treeIndexOfMind(id) { return mindOrder(state.mind).indexOf(id); }

  /* 结构一致则只同步文案、保留手动位置；结构变了则重新布局 */
  function syncMind() {
    var order = mindOrder(state.mind);
    var same = order.length === state.tree.length && state.tree.length > 0;
    if (same) {
      var byId = {};
      state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { byId[n.id] = n; });
      var depth = {};
      function d(id) {
        if (depth[id] != null) return depth[id];
        var n = byId[id];
        depth[id] = (!n || !n.parent || !byId[n.parent]) ? 0 : d(n.parent) + 1;
        return depth[id];
      }
      for (var i = 0; i < state.tree.length; i++) {
        var mn = byId[order[i]];
        if (!mn || (d(order[i]) - 1) !== state.tree[i].lv) { same = false; break; }
      }
      if (same) {
        for (var j = 0; j < state.tree.length; j++) {
          byId[order[j]].text = (state.tree[j].text || "").trim() || "…";
        }
        if (!state.mmSel || !mindNode(state.mmSel)) state.mmSel = state.mind.root;
        return false;
      }
    }
    state.mind = state.tree.length ? mindFromTree(state.tree, titleText()) : null;
    state.mmSel = state.mind ? state.mind.root : null;
    return !!state.mind;
  }

  function renderMind() {
    var svg = qs("#mmSvg"), mind = state.mind;
    if (!mind || !mind.nodes || !mind.nodes.length) {
      svg.innerHTML = "";
      qs("#mmEmpty").style.display = "grid";
      return;
    }
    qs("#mmEmpty").style.display = "none";
    var byId = {}; mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { byId[n.id] = n; });
    var v = state.mmView;
    var out = '<g transform="translate(' + v.x + ',' + v.y + ') scale(' + v.k + ')">';
    mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) {
      if (!n.parent || !byId[n.parent]) return;
      var p = byId[n.parent], pb = nodeBox(p), nb = nodeBox(n);
      var x1 = p.x + pb.w, y1 = p.y + pb.h / 2, x2 = n.x, y2 = n.y + nb.h / 2, mx = (x1 + x2) / 2;
      out += '<path class="mm-edge" d="M' + x1 + " " + y1 + " C" + mx + " " + y1 + " " + mx + " " + y2 + " " + x2 + " " + y2 + '"/>';
    });
    mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) {
      var b = nodeBox(n);
      out += '<g class="mm-node' + (n.id === mind.root ? " root" : "") + (n.id === state.mmSel ? " sel" : "") + '" data-id="' + n.id + '" transform="translate(' + n.x + "," + n.y + ')">' +
        '<rect width="' + b.w + '" height="' + b.h + '" rx="3"/>' +
        '<text x="' + b.w / 2 + '" y="' + (b.h / 2 + 4) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + esc(n.text) + "</text>" +
        '<g class="mm-plus" data-add="' + n.id + '" transform="translate(' + (b.w + 10) + "," + (b.h / 2) + ')">' +
        '<circle r="8"/><line x1="-4" x2="4" y1="0" y2="0"/><line x1="0" x2="0" y1="-4" y2="4"/></g>' +
        "</g>";
    });
    out += "</g>";
    svg.innerHTML = out;
    qs("#mmZoomVal").textContent = Math.round(v.k * 100) + "%";
  }

  function fitMind() {
    if (!state.mind || !state.mind.nodes.length) return;
    var stage = qs("#mmStage");
    var W = stage.clientWidth || 640, H = stage.clientHeight || 470;
    var minX = 1e9, minY = 1e9, maxX = -1e9, maxY = -1e9;
    state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) {
      var b = nodeBox(n);
      minX = Math.min(minX, n.x); minY = Math.min(minY, n.y);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, n.x + b.w); maxY = Math.max(maxY, n.y + b.h);
    });
    var pad = 64;
    var k = Math.min(1.15, Math.min((W - pad * 2) / Math.max(1, maxX - minX), (H - pad * 2) / Math.max(1, maxY - minY)));
    k = Math.max(0.35, k);
    state.mmView.k = k;
    state.mmView.x = (W - (maxX - minX) * k) / 2 - minX * k;
    state.mmView.y = (H - (maxY - minY) * k) / 2 - minY * k;
  }

  function selectNode(id) {
    state.mmSel = id;
    var n = mindNode(id);
    qs("#mmEdit").value = n ? n.text : "";
    renderMind();
  }

  /* 脑图新增子节点 → 写回树（树为真相），随后重新布局 */
  function mmAddChild(parentId) {
    var order = mindOrder(state.mind);
    var pIdx = order.indexOf(parentId);
    var insertAt, lv;
    if (pIdx < 0) { insertAt = state.tree.length; lv = 0; }
    else { insertAt = blockEnd(pIdx); lv = Math.min(4, state.tree[pIdx].lv + 1); }
    state.tree.splice(insertAt, 0, newNode(lv, "新节点"));
    syncMind(); fitMind();
    var order2 = mindOrder(state.mind);
    selectNode(order2[insertAt]);
    renderOutline(); updateHint();
    qs("#mmEdit").focus(); qs("#mmEdit").select();
  }

  /* 脑图删除节点 → 子树整体上提一级（与树的层级语义一致） */
  function mmDelNode() {
    if (!state.mind || !state.mmSel) return;
    if (state.mmSel === state.mind.root) { toast("根节点不可删除", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    var idx = treeIndexOfMind(state.mmSel);
    if (idx < 0) return;
    var lv = state.tree[idx].lv;
    state.tree.splice(idx, 1);
    for (var j = idx; j < state.tree.length; j++) {
      if (state.tree[j].lv > lv) state.tree[j].lv--; else break;
    }
    state.mmSel = null;
    syncMind(); fitMind(); renderMind(); renderOutline(); updateHint();
  }

  /* 按脑图布局（先 y 后 x 的中序）重排大纲 */
  function reorderByMind() {
    if (!state.mind) return;
    var byId = {}; state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { byId[n.id] = n; });
    var kids = {};
    state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { (kids[n.parent] = kids[n.parent] || []).push(n); });
    var rows = [];
    (function walk(id, lv) {
      (kids[id] || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y || a.x - b.x; }).forEach(function (c) {
        var idx = treeIndexOfMind(c.id);
        var r = idx >= 0 ? state.tree[idx] : null;
        if (r) { r.lv = Math.min(4, lv); rows.push(r); }
        walk(c.id, lv + 1);
      });
    })(state.mind.root, 0);
    if (rows.length !== state.tree.length) { toast("脑图与大纲条目不一致，先补齐再重排", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    /* v2.11 Bug2：重排前快照整棵树 —— toast 带「撤销」（MD3 Snackbar Undo），一键还原 */
    var before = state.tree.map(function (r) { return Object.assign({}, r); });
    state.tree = rows;
    syncMind(); renderMind(); renderOutline(); updateHint();
    setDirty(true);   /* 重排也走既有 2.5s 自动保存链路 */
    toast("已按脑图布局重排大纲", "list-tree", function () {
      state.tree = before.map(function (r) { return Object.assign({}, r); });
      syncMind(); renderMind(); renderOutline(); updateHint();
      setDirty(true);
      toast("已撤销重排", "undo-2");
    });
  }

  qs("#mmEdit").addEventListener("input", function () {
    var idx = treeIndexOfMind(state.mmSel);
    if (idx < 0) return;
    var v = qs("#mmEdit").value;
    state.tree[idx].text = v;
    var n = mindNode(state.mmSel); if (n) n.text = v || "…";
    renderMind(); updateHint();
  });
  qs("#mmAdd").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!state.tree.length) {
      state.tree.push(newNode(0, "新节点"));
      syncMind(); fitMind(); renderMind();
      selectNode(mindOrder(state.mind)[0]);
      renderOutline(); updateHint();
      qs("#mmEdit").focus(); qs("#mmEdit").select();
      return;
    }
    mmAddChild(state.mmSel || state.mind.root);
  });
  qs("#mmDel").addEventListener("click", mmDelNode);
  qs("#mmOrder").addEventListener("click", reorderByMind);
  qs("#mmZoomIn").addEventListener("click", function () { mmZoom(1.15); });
  qs("#mmZoomOut").addEventListener("click", function () { mmZoom(0.87); });
  qs("#mmFit").addEventListener("click", function () { fitMind(); renderMind(); });

  function mmZoom(f) {
    if (!state.mind) return;
    var v = state.mmView, stage = qs("#mmStage");
    var mx = stage.clientWidth / 2, my = stage.clientHeight / 2;
    var k2 = Math.min(2.4, Math.max(0.35, v.k * f));
    v.x = mx - (mx - v.x) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.y = my - (my - v.y) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.k = k2;
    renderMind();
  }

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".mm-tools, .mm-zoom")) return;
    var add = e.target.closest(".mm-plus");
    if (add) { e.preventDefault(); mmAddChild(add.dataset.add); return; }
    var node = e.target.closest(".mm-node");
    if (node) {
      var id = node.dataset.id;
      selectNode(id);
      var w = mmToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY), n = mindNode(id);
      state.mmDrag = { kind: "node", id: id, dx: n.x - w.x, dy: n.y - w.y };
      if (qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture) qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      return;
    }
    if (!state.mind || !state.mind.nodes.length) return;
    state.mmDrag = { kind: "pan", sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, vx: state.mmView.x, vy: state.mmView.y };
    qs("#mmStage").classList.add("panning");
    if (qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture) qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    var d = state.mmDrag; if (!d) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (d.kind === "pan") {
      state.mmView.x = d.vx + (e.clientX - d.sx);
      state.mmView.y = d.vy + (e.clientY - d.sy);
      renderMind();
    } else {
      var w = mmToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY), n = mindNode(d.id);
      if (n) { n.x = Math.round(w.x + d.dx); n.y = Math.round(w.y + d.dy); renderMind(); }
    }
  });

  function endMmDrag() {
    if (!state.mmDrag) return;
    qs("#mmStage").classList.remove("panning");
    state.mmDrag = null;
  }
  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointerup", endMmDrag);
  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointercancel", endMmDrag);

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("wheel", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".mm-tools, .mm-zoom")) return;
    if (!state.mind || !state.mind.nodes.length) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var v = state.mmView, r = qs("#mmStage").getBoundingClientRect();
    var mx = e.clientX - r.left, my = e.clientY - r.top;
    var k2 = Math.min(2.4, Math.max(0.35, v.k * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.89)));
    v.x = mx - (mx - v.x) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.y = my - (my - v.y) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.k = k2;
    renderMind();
  }, { passive: false });

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("dblclick", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".mm-node, .mm-plus, .mm-tools, .mm-zoom")) return;
    var w = mmToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    var first = !state.tree.length;
    state.tree.push(newNode(0, "新节点"));
    syncMind();
    if (first) fitMind();
    var order = mindOrder(state.mind);
    var nid = order[order.length - 1];
    var mn = mindNode(nid);
    if (mn && !first) { mn.x = Math.round(w.x); mn.y = Math.round(w.y); }
    selectNode(nid);
    renderOutline(); updateHint();
    qs("#mmEdit").focus(); qs("#mmEdit").select();
  });

  /* ============================================================
     三、Markdown · LaTeX（树的实时序列化）
     ============================================================ */
  function syncPreview() {
    qs("#preview").innerHTML = MD.render(qs("#mdEditor").value) || '<span class="ef-hint">预览区（空）</span>';
  }
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("input", function () {
    syncPreview();
    clearTimeout(state.mdTimer);
    state.mdTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      state.tree = parse(qs("#mdEditor").value);
      updateHint();
    }, 300);
  });

  /* data-md 工具钮与 Ctrl+B / I / K 快捷键共用的插入逻辑（原点击逻辑原样提取） */
  function applyMd(mk) {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    var s = ta.selectionStart, e = ta.selectionEnd, v = ta.value, sel = v.slice(s, e);
    var ins;
    if (mk === "table") ins = "\n| 列 A | 列 B |\n| --- | --- |\n| 值 1 | 值 2 |\n";
    else if (mk === "$$") ins = "\n$$\n" + (sel || "C_{total}=\\alpha\\bar{t}+\\beta r+\\gamma L") + "\n$$\n";
    else if (mk === "[文字](链接)") ins = "[" + (sel || "文字") + "](https://)";
    else if (mk === "`") ins = "`" + (sel || "code") + "`";
    else if (mk === "## " || mk === "- " || mk === "1. " || mk === "> ") ins = mk + (sel || "内容");
    else ins = mk + (sel || "文本") + mk;
    ta.value = v.slice(0, s) + ins + v.slice(e);
    ta.focus();
    ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = s + ins.length;
    syncPreview();
    state.tree = parse(ta.value);
    updateHint();
    setDirty(true);
    if (imm.on) setTimeout(centerCaret, 0);
  }

  qsa("[data-md]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () { applyMd(b.dataset.md); });
  });

  /* ---------- Typora 式快捷键：Ctrl/Cmd+B 加粗 · I 斜体 · K 链接 · Tab 列表缩进 ---------- */
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey) {
      var k = (e.key || "").toLowerCase();
      if (k === "b") { e.preventDefault(); applyMd("**"); return; }
      if (k === "i") { e.preventDefault(); applyMd("*"); return; }
      if (k === "k") { e.preventDefault(); applyMd("[文字](链接)"); return; }
    }
    if (e.key === "Tab" && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      mdIndent(e.shiftKey);
    }
  });

  /* Tab / Shift+Tab：列表行（- 、1. 、> 前缀）插 / 移两空格缩进（多行选区整块生效）；
     普通行 Tab 在光标处插两空格（阻止默认失焦）；Shift+Tab 无处可退时不动 */
  function mdIndent(outdent) {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    var v = ta.value, s = ta.selectionStart, e2 = ta.selectionEnd;
    var ls = v.lastIndexOf("\n", s - 1) + 1;                    /* 选区首行行首 */
    var le = v.indexOf("\n", e2); if (le < 0) le = v.length;    /* 选区末行行尾 */
    var lines = v.slice(ls, le).split("\n");
    var multi = lines.length > 1;
    var first = lines[0];
    var isList = /^(\s*)(?:[-*+]|\d+\.)\s/.test(first) || /^(\s*)>\s/.test(first);

    if (!outdent && !isList && !multi) {
      ta.value = v.slice(0, s) + "  " + v.slice(e2);
      ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = s + 2;
    } else if (isList || (outdent && /^\s/.test(first))) {
      var d1 = 0;
      var nl = lines.map(function (l, ix) {
        if (!l.trim()) return l;                                /* 空行不动 */
        if (outdent) {
          var m = l.match(/^ {1,2}/), rm = m ? m[0].length : 0;
          if (ix === 0) d1 = -rm;
          return l.slice(rm);
        }
        if (ix === 0) d1 = 2;
        return "  " + l;
      }).join("\n");
      ta.value = v.slice(0, ls) + nl + v.slice(le);
      if (multi) ta.setSelectionRange(ls, ls + nl.length);
      else ta.setSelectionRange(Math.max(ls, s + d1), Math.max(ls, e2 + d1));
    } else {
      return;
    }
    syncPreview();
    state.tree = parse(ta.value);
    updateHint();
    setDirty(true);
    if (imm.on) setTimeout(centerCaret, 0);
  }

  qs("#btnPreview").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var split = qs("#mdSplit");
    var only = split.classList.toggle("preview-only");
    qs("#btnPreview").classList.toggle("active", only);
    if (only) syncPreview();
  });

  /* ---------- B2 专注模式（v2.10 · 真·跟随光标） ----------
     语义与 Typora 的 on-focus-mode 一致：当前段落正常、其余淡出、随光标走。
     编辑器侧用「镜像测量 + 覆盖高亮带」实现（textarea 无法按段着色），
     预览/大纲侧按块降灰并点亮命中项。偏好键沿用 inkread.mdfocus.v1（旧值直接兼容）。 */
  var LS_MDFOCUS = "inkread.mdfocus.v1";
  var mdBand = null, mdMirror = null, mdRaf = 0;
  function mdFocusOn() { return document.body.classList.contains("md-focus"); }

  function mdFocusNodes() {
    if (mdBand) return;
    var split = qs("#mdSplit");
    if (!split) return;
    mdBand = document.createElement("div");
    mdBand.id = "mdFocusBand";
    mdBand.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    mdMirror = document.createElement("div");
    mdMirror.id = "mdMirror";
    mdMirror.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    split.appendChild(mdBand);
    split.appendChild(mdMirror);
  }
  /* 把编辑器的字体与盒模型抄给镜像，保证换行位置一致（换行不一致，测出来的行就错了） */
  function mdMirrorSync() {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    if (!ta || !mdMirror) return null;
    var cs = getComputedStyle(ta);
    ["fontFamily", "fontSize", "fontWeight", "fontStyle", "letterSpacing", "lineHeight",
     "paddingTop", "paddingBottom", "paddingLeft", "paddingRight", "boxSizing", "tabSize"].forEach(function (p) {
      mdMirror.style[p] = cs[p];
    });
    mdMirror.style.width = ta.clientWidth + "px";
    return ta;
  }
  /* 第 offset 个字符落在镜像里的纵向位置（相对镜像的 padding box） */
  function mdYAt(offset) {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    mdMirror.textContent = ta.value.slice(0, offset);
    var mark = document.createElement("span");
    mark.textContent = "\u200b";
    mdMirror.appendChild(mark);
    var y = mark.offsetTop;
    mdMirror.textContent = "";
    return y;
  }
  /* 焦点单元＝光标所在的那一行（含软换行，不含行尾换行符）。
     为什么按「行」而不是「相邻非空行合成段」：本页 Markdown 方言里，
     一个「## 标题」下的连续「- 条目」在源码上就是连续的若干行 ——
     若把相邻行合成一段，一条 18 项的清单会变成一块 1000px 高的高亮带（实测过），
     既不是 Typora 的块语义（它按块/列表项），对「我现在写的是哪一条」也没有帮助。 */
  function mdCaretLine(v, at) {
    var start = v.lastIndexOf("\n", at - 1) + 1;
    var end = v.indexOf("\n", at); if (end < 0) end = v.length;
    return { start: start, end: end, text: v.slice(start, end) };
  }
  /* 预览区与大纲：命中的那一块/那一条保持原色，其余降灰 */
  function mdFocusHighlight(text) {
    var key = (text || "").replace(/^[#>*\-\s\d\.]+/, "").replace(/\s+/g, "").slice(0, 12);
    ["#preview", "#olList"].forEach(function (sel) {
      var box = qs(sel);
      if (!box) return;
      var hit = null;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(box.children, function (el) {
        el.classList.remove("mdf-on");
        if (!hit && key && el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, "").indexOf(key) >= 0) { hit = el; el.classList.add("mdf-on"); }
      });
    });
  }
  function mdFocusPaint() {
    mdFocusNodes();
    if (!mdBand) return;
    if (!mdFocusOn()) { mdBand.style.opacity = 0; return; }
    var ta = mdMirrorSync();
    if (!ta) return;
    var v = ta.value, at = ta.selectionStart == null ? 0 : ta.selectionStart;
    var par = mdCaretLine(v, at);
    /* 行顶：本行行首的 y；行底：下一行行首的 y（末行没有下一行，退回行高） */
    var y0 = mdYAt(par.start);
    var y1 = par.end < v.length ? mdYAt(par.end + 1) : 0;
    if (!y1 || y1 <= y0) {
      var lh = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ta).lineHeight);
      if (!lh || isNaN(lh)) lh = (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ta).fontSize) || 16) * 1.6;
      y1 = y0 + lh;
    }
    mdBand.style.left = ta.offsetLeft + "px";
    mdBand.style.width = ta.clientWidth + "px";
    mdBand.style.top = (ta.offsetTop + y0 - ta.scrollTop) + "px";
    mdBand.style.height = Math.max(2, y1 - y0) + "px";
    mdBand.style.opacity = 1;
    mdFocusHighlight(par.text);
  }
  function mdFocusSoon() {
    if (mdRaf) return;
    mdRaf = requestAnimationFrame(function () { mdRaf = 0; if (mdFocusOn()) mdFocusPaint(); });
  }
  function setMdFocus(on, persist) {
    document.body.classList.toggle("md-focus", !!on);
    var b = qs("#btnMdFocus");
    if (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", !!on); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false"); }
    if (persist) { try { localStorage.setItem(LS_MDFOCUS, on ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {} }
    if (on) { mdFocusPaint(); } else { if (mdBand) mdBand.style.opacity = 0; mdFocusHighlight(""); }
  }
  (function initMdFocus() {
    var v = "0";
    try { v = localStorage.getItem(LS_MDFOCUS) || "0"; } catch (e) {}
    setMdFocus(v === "1", false);
  })();
  /* 光标一动就重画：键盘、鼠标、滚动、输入都覆盖（rAF 节流，不做逐次测量） */
  (function bindMdFocus() {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    if (!ta) return;
    ["keyup", "keydown", "click", "input", "select", "scroll", "focus"].forEach(function (ev) {
      ta.addEventListener(ev, mdFocusSoon, true);
    });
    ta.addEventListener("blur", function () { setTimeout(mdFocusSoon, 0); });
    window.addEventListener("resize", mdFocusSoon);
    /* 预览与大纲是「由编辑器内容重建 innerHTML」的（输入即重渲染），
       重建会连命中标记一起冲掉 —— 监听子树变化后重贴一次，标记才不会闪没。 */
    if (window.MutationObserver) {
      ["#preview", "#olList"].forEach(function (sel) {
        var box = qs(sel);
        if (!box) return;
        new MutationObserver(function () { if (mdFocusOn()) mdFocusSoon(); }).observe(box, { childList: true });
      });
    }
  })();
  qs("#btnMdFocus").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var on = !mdFocusOn();
    setMdFocus(on, true);
    if (on && imm.on && state.view === "md") setTimeout(centerCaret, 30);
    toast(on ? "专注模式开 · 跟随光标所在段落，其余淡出（Esc 退出）" : "专注模式关", "focus");
  });
  /* Esc 退出专注（沉浸写作的 Esc 优先，不抢它的活） */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (window.InkKeys && InkKeys.isOpen()) return;   /* 命令面板 / 总览置顶：Esc 先归它们 */
    if (e.key !== "Escape" || !mdFocusOn() || imm.on) return;
    if (state.view !== "md") return;
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    setMdFocus(false, true);
    toast("专注模式关 · 已退出跟随", "focus");
  }, true);
  qs("#btnMdFocus").title = "专注模式（当前段落常亮 · 其余淡出 · Esc 退出）";

  /* ---------- B3 分栏滚动同步：编辑 ⇄ 预览按同比例互滚；rAF 节流 + 单向锁防同步循环 ---------- */
  var mdSyncLock = null, mdSyncRaf = 0;
  function mdSyncTo(src, dst) {
    if (mdSyncLock && mdSyncLock !== src) return;   /* 正被对方同步：不回写 */
    mdSyncLock = src;
    if (mdSyncRaf) return;
    mdSyncRaf = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      mdSyncRaf = 0;
      var smax = src.scrollHeight - src.clientHeight;
      var dmax = dst.scrollHeight - dst.clientHeight;
      if (smax > 2 && dmax > 2) dst.scrollTop = (src.scrollTop / smax) * dmax;
      setTimeout(function () { if (mdSyncLock === src) mdSyncLock = null; }, 90);
    });
  }
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("scroll", function () {
    var pv = qs("#preview");
    if (pv && pv.offsetParent) mdSyncTo(qs("#mdEditor"), pv);   /* 对方不可见（沉浸单栏 / 仅预览 / 非本视图）不同步 */
  });
  qs("#preview").addEventListener("scroll", function () {
    var ed = qs("#mdEditor");
    if (ed && ed.offsetParent) mdSyncTo(qs("#preview"), ed);
  });

  /* ============================================================
     笔记页增强 v14：MD 双栏可拖拽分隔 · 沉浸栏宽可调 · 自动保存
     布局变量：--md-a / --md-b（左右栏 fr 配比，写在 #mdSplit 内联样式）
              --nw-measure（沉浸正文窄列宽度，写在 documentElement）
     ============================================================ */
  var LS_MDSPLIT = "inkread.mdsplit.v1";     /* 左栏占比 0~1 */
  var LS_NWMEASURE = "inkread.nwmeasure.v1"; /* 沉浸栏宽 px */

  /* ---------- A. MD 双栏拖拽（普通态 + 沉浸开预览态共用） ---------- */
  var mdSplitEl = qs("#mdSplit"), mdGrip = qs("#mdGrip");
  var mdRatio = null, gripDrag = null;
  function setMdRatio(r, persist) {
    mdRatio = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(0.9, r));
    mdSplitEl.style.setProperty("--md-a", (mdRatio * 100).toFixed(2) + "fr");
    mdSplitEl.style.setProperty("--md-b", ((1 - mdRatio) * 100).toFixed(2) + "fr");
    if (persist) { try { localStorage.setItem(LS_MDSPLIT, String(mdRatio)); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  (function initMdSplit() {
    var v = 0;
    try { v = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem(LS_MDSPLIT)); } catch (e) {}
    if (v >= 0.1 && v <= 0.9) setMdRatio(v, false);
  })();
  mdGrip.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    gripDrag = true;
    mdGrip.classList.add("drag");
    document.body.classList.add("md-col-drag");
    if (mdGrip.setPointerCapture) mdGrip.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  mdGrip.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    if (!gripDrag) return;
    var r = mdSplitEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width > 0) setMdRatio((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width, false);
  });
  function endGripDrag() {
    if (!gripDrag) return;
    gripDrag = null;
    mdGrip.classList.remove("drag");
    document.body.classList.remove("md-col-drag");
    if (mdRatio != null) setMdRatio(mdRatio, true);   /* 拖完落盘 */
  }
  mdGrip.addEventListener("pointerup", endGripDrag);
  mdGrip.addEventListener("pointercancel", endGripDrag);
  mdGrip.addEventListener("dblclick", function () {
    mdRatio = null;
    mdSplitEl.style.removeProperty("--md-a");
    mdSplitEl.style.removeProperty("--md-b");
    try { localStorage.removeItem(LS_MDSPLIT); } catch (e) {}
  });

  /* ---------- B. 沉浸栏宽：滑杆 → --nw-measure，进入沉浸自动生效 ---------- */
  var NW_MIN = 540, NW_MAX = 1180, NW_STEP = 20, NW_DEFAULT = 680;
  function applyMeasure(px, persist) {
    px = Math.max(NW_MIN, Math.min(NW_MAX, Math.round(px / NW_STEP) * NW_STEP));
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--nw-measure", px + "px");
    qs("#nwWidth").value = String(px);
    qs("#nwWidthVal").textContent = px;
    if (persist) { try { localStorage.setItem(LS_NWMEASURE, String(px)); } catch (e) {} }
    return px;
  }
  (function initMeasure() {
    var v = 0;
    try { v = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(LS_NWMEASURE), 10); } catch (e) {}
    applyMeasure(v >= NW_MIN && v <= NW_MAX ? v : NW_DEFAULT, false);
  })();
  qs("#nwWidth").addEventListener("input", function (e) { applyMeasure(+e.target.value, false); });
  qs("#nwWidth").addEventListener("change", function (e) { applyMeasure(+e.target.value, true); });

  /* ============================================================
     筛选 / 新建 / 保存 / 删除 / 导出
     ============================================================ */
  qsa("#kindSeg .seg-btn").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      qsa("#kindSeg .seg-btn").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); });
      b.classList.add("on"); state.kind = b.dataset.kind; renderList();
    });
  });
  qsa("#ntypeSeg .seg-btn").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      qsa("#ntypeSeg .seg-btn").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); });
      b.classList.add("on"); state.ntype = b.dataset.ntype; renderList();
    });
  });
  qsa("#colorDots .theme-dot").forEach(function (d) {
    d.addEventListener("click", function () {
      qsa("#colorDots .theme-dot").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); });
      d.classList.add("on"); state.color = d.dataset.color; renderList();
    });
  });
  qs("#docFilter").addEventListener("change", function (e) { state.doc = e.target.value; renderList(); });

  /* ---------- v2.12 自由文本搜索：120ms 防抖即时过滤；Esc 清空；type=search 原生 ✕ 走 input 事件 ---------- */
  var searchTimer = null;
  function clearSearch() {
    if (searchTimer) { clearTimeout(searchTimer); searchTimer = null; }
    state.q = "";
    qs("#noteSearch").value = "";
    renderList();
  }
  qs("#noteSearch").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
    if (searchTimer) clearTimeout(searchTimer);
    var v = e.target.value;
    searchTimer = setTimeout(function () { state.q = v; renderList(); }, 120);
  });
  qs("#noteSearch").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && e.target.value) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      clearSearch();
      qs("#noteSearch").blur();
    }
  });

  function newNote() {
    state.curId = null;
    qs("#titleInput").value = "";
    qs("#srcChip").style.display = "none";
    qs("#gotoSrc").style.display = "none";
    qs("#btnDel").disabled = true;
    state.tree = state.view === "mindmap" ? [] : [newNode(0, "")];
    state.olFocus = 0; state.olSel = null;
    state.mind = null; state.mmSel = null;
    qs("#mmEdit").value = "";
    setView(state.view);
    renderList();
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (state.view === "outline") focusRow(0, false);
      else if (state.view === "md") qs("#mdEditor").focus();
      else qs("#mmEdit").focus();
    }, 30);
  }
  qs("#btnNew").addEventListener("click", newNote);

  /* ---------- 保存：手动 / 自动共用 saveNow；2.5s 防抖自动保存 ---------- */
  var autoTimer = null;                          /* 自动保存防抖句柄 */
  var lastSave = { at: null, auto: false };      /* 最近一次成功保存（用于状态文字） */
  var quotaWarned = false;                       /* 存储写不进去的提醒每会话只弹一次（自动档） */
  function pad2(x) { return ("0" + x).slice(-2); }
  function hmOf(d) { return pad2(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad2(d.getMinutes()); }

  /* 状态文字：脏 → 「未保存」；干净 → 「已保存/已自动保存 HH:MM」（首次为「已保存」） */
  function renderSaveStatus() {
    var d = qs("#nwDirty"), b = qs("#btnSaveLabel");
    if (!d) return;
    if (state.dirty) {
      d.dataset.dirty = "on"; d.textContent = "未保存";
      if (b) b.textContent = "保存";
      return;
    }
    d.dataset.dirty = "off";
    var txt = "已保存";
    if (lastSave.at) txt = (lastSave.auto ? "已自动保存 " : "已保存 ") + hmOf(lastSave.at);
    d.textContent = txt;
    if (b) b.textContent = lastSave.at ? txt : "保存";
  }
  function scheduleAutoSave() {
    if (autoTimer) clearTimeout(autoTimer);
    autoTimer = setTimeout(function () { autoTimer = null; saveNow(false); }, 2500);
  }

  async function saveNow(manual) {
    if (autoTimer) { clearTimeout(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }   /* 手动保存取消挂起的防抖 */
    if (state.saving) { if (!manual) scheduleAutoSave(); return; }  /* 上一轮还没落盘，自动档稍后再试 */
    if (state.view === "md") flushMd();
    clearTimeout(state.mdTimer);
    var rows = state.tree.filter(function (r) { return (r.text || "").trim(); });
    if (!rows.length) {
      if (manual) toast("先写点内容吧", "alert-triangle");
      return;   /* 空笔记不自动保存，静默跳过 */
    }
    var existing = state.notes.find(function (n) { return n.id === state.curId; });
    var note = {
      id: existing ? existing.id : null,
      docId: existing ? existing.docId : curDocId(),
      kind: existing ? existing.kind : "note",
      color: existing ? existing.color : "blue",
      ntype: state.view,
      title: qs("#titleInput").value.trim(),
      text: rows[0].text,
      anchor: existing ? existing.anchor : "sec-1",
      page: existing ? existing.page : 1,
      body: serialize(state.tree),
      outline: state.tree.map(function (r) {
        return { id: r.id, lv: r.lv, text: r.text, done: !!r.done, folded: !!r.folded, pri: r.pri | 0, tag: r.tag || "", md: r.md || "" };
      }),
      mind: state.mind ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.mind)) : null
    };
    state.saving = true;
    var seqAtSave = state.editSeq | 0;   /* 落盘前记下改动序号，期间有新输入就不算保存完成 */
    var b = qs("#btnSave"); b.disabled = true;
    try {
      var r = await API.saveNote(note);
      if (existing) Object.assign(existing, r.data);
      else { state.notes.unshift(r.data); state.curId = r.data.id; }
      if (r.stored !== false) lastSave = { at: new Date(), auto: !manual };   /* 没落盘就不记「已保存」时刻 */
      renderList();
      if (r.stored === false) {
        /* 存储写不进去（配额满 / 禁写）：内容只在本会话内存里 —— 不许说「已保存」，
           手动档把实情摊开；自动档每会话只提醒一次，别等用户关页才发现丢稿。 */
        openNote(state.curId);
        if (manual || !quotaWarned) {
          quotaWarned = true;
          toast("笔记没能写入本机存储（空间已满或被禁用）· 本次会话内可继续编辑，关闭前请先导出", "alert-triangle");
        }
      } else if (manual) {
        openNote(state.curId);   /* 原逻辑：回读刷新三视图 */
        InkFX.flash();           /* 墨屏一闪只给手动保存，自动保存静默不打断书写 */
        toast("笔记已保存 · 三视图同源 · 双端已同步", "circle-check");
      } else if ((state.editSeq | 0) === seqAtSave) {
        setDirty(false);         /* 自动档不重开笔记，避免打断输入中的光标 */
      } else {
        scheduleAutoSave();      /* 保存期间又有输入：重新排程，保住最新内容 */
      }
    } finally {
      state.saving = false;
      b.disabled = false;
      renderSaveStatus();
    }
  }
  qs("#btnSave").addEventListener("click", function () { saveNow(true); });

  qs("#btnDel").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    if (!state.curId) return;
    await API.deleteNote(state.curId);
    state.notes = state.notes.filter(function (n) { return n.id !== state.curId; });
    state.curId = null;
    qs("#titleInput").value = "";
    qs("#srcChip").style.display = "none"; qs("#gotoSrc").style.display = "none";
    qs("#btnDel").disabled = true;
    state.tree = []; state.mind = null;
    setView(state.view);
    renderList();
    setDirty(false);
    toast("笔记已删除", "trash-2");
  });

  /* 导出交给 app.js 的 InkExport（与书架、阅读页同一条实现，Markdown / CSV / 可还原 JSON 三选一）。
     行还是按「当前筛选与搜索」摆：范围跟着屏幕走，导出件才对得上刚看到的那一屏。
     大纲型笔记没有 body，正文取 serialize(outline) —— 与旧版导出的取字口径一致。 */
  qs("#btnExport").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var list = filtered();
    var rows = list.map(function (n) {
      return InkExport.row(n, {
        title: noteTitle(n) || "无标题",
        doc: docTitle(n.docId),
        loc: n.page ? "第 " + n.page + " 页" : "",
        body: (n.outline && n.outline.length) ? serialize(n.outline) : (n.body || "")
      });
    });
    InkExport.open({
      rows: rows, mdTitle: "墨读笔记导出", base: "inkread-notes",
      scope: list.length === state.notes.length ? "全部笔记" : "当前筛选与搜索"
    });
  });

  /* ============================================================
     沉浸写作（v12）：三视图共用一套状态，切视图只藏 chrome、不新建页面
     文字模式窄列 + 打字机滚动（光标恒在视区中线）；脑图画布铺满；
     当前段落清晰、其余淡化；浮条 3.2s 无操作收起，Esc / 浮条退出。
     ============================================================ */
  var imm = { on: false, timer: null };

  function setDirty(v) {
    /* 任何改动（输入 / 切视图 / 勾选大纲…）都重排 2.5s 防抖自动保存；置干净则撤销排程 */
    if (v) { state.editSeq = (state.editSeq | 0) + 1; scheduleAutoSave(); }
    else if (autoTimer) { clearTimeout(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
    if (!!state.dirty === !!v) return;
    state.dirty = !!v;
    renderSaveStatus();
  }
  function immMeta() {
    var el = qs("#nwMeta");
    if (!el) return;
    var n = state.tree.filter(function (r) { return (r.text || "").trim(); }).length;
    var c = state.tree.reduce(function (a, r) { return a + String(r.text || "").length; }, 0);
    el.textContent = VSHORT[state.view] + " · " + n + " 条 · " + c + " 字";
  }
  function immTabs() {
    qsa("#nwTabs .nw-tab").forEach(function (t) {
      var on = t.dataset.view === state.view;
      t.classList.toggle("active", on);
      t.setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
    });
  }

  /* 打字机滚动：把焦点行/光标所在行推到容器垂直中线 */
  function centerRow(ta) {
    if (!imm.on || !ta) return;
    var wrap = ta.closest(".ol-wrap");
    if (!wrap) return;
    var r = ta.getBoundingClientRect(), w = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    var dy = (r.top + r.height / 2) - (w.top + w.height / 2);
    if (Math.abs(dy) > 4) wrap.scrollTop += dy;
  }
  function centerCaret() {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    if (!imm.on || !ta || document.activeElement !== ta) return;
    var st = getComputedStyle(ta);
    var lh = parseFloat(st.lineHeight) || 26;
    var pt = parseFloat(st.paddingTop) || 0;
    var lines = ta.value.slice(0, ta.selectionStart).split("\n").length - 1;
    ta.scrollTop = Math.max(0, pt + lines * lh - ta.clientHeight / 2 + lh / 2);
  }

  function immEnter() {
    if (imm.on) return;
    if (state.view !== "mindmap" && !state.tree.length) { state.tree = [newNode(0, "")]; setView(state.view); }
    imm.on = true;
    document.body.classList.add("nw");
    immTabs(); immMeta(); setDirty(state.dirty); wake();
    if (state.view === "mindmap") { fitMind(); renderMind(); }
    else if (state.view === "md") { setTimeout(centerCaret, 40); }
    else { setTimeout(function () { focusRow(state.olFocus, true); centerRow(qs('.ol-input[data-i="' + state.olFocus + '"]')); }, 40); }
  }
  function immExit() {
    if (!imm.on) return;
    imm.on = false;
    document.body.classList.remove("nw");
    var bar = qs("#nwBar");
    bar.classList.add("hide"); bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    clearTimeout(imm.timer); imm.timer = null;
  }
  function wake() {
    if (!imm.on) return;
    var bar = qs("#nwBar");
    if (bar.classList.contains("hide")) { bar.classList.remove("hide"); bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false"); }
    clearTimeout(imm.timer);
    imm.timer = setTimeout(function () {
      if (!imm.on || bar.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
      bar.classList.add("hide"); bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    }, 3200);
  }

  qs("#btnImm").addEventListener("click", immEnter);
  qs("#nwExit").addEventListener("click", immExit);
  qs("#nwSave").addEventListener("click", function () { saveNow(true); });
  qsa("#nwTabs .nw-tab").forEach(function (t) {
    t.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (t.dataset.view === state.view) return;
      setView(t.dataset.view);
      wake();
      if (state.view === "md") setTimeout(centerCaret, 30);
      if (state.view === "mindmap") { fitMind(); renderMind(); }
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener("pointermove", wake, { passive: true });
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", wake, { passive: true });
  /* v2.22 S5：Ctrl/Cmd+S 与 F（沉浸写作）移入 InkKeys 注册表；
     Ctrl+S inInput:true 保持「全页可用」原语义；F 用默认字段守卫
     （INPUT/TEXTAREA/contenteditable 放行，与原实现逐项一致）。
     Escape（退出沉浸）留局部。 */
  if (window.InkKeys) {
    InkKeys.on("mod+s", function () { saveNow(true); }, { inInput: true, title: "保存笔记", group: "笔记" });
    InkKeys.on("f", function () { if (imm.on) immExit(); else immEnter(); }, { title: "沉浸写作", group: "笔记" });
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && imm.on) { e.preventDefault(); immExit(); return; }
  });

  /* 任何落笔都算改动：输入框走 input，结构操作走一次委托点击 */
  qs("#appContent").addEventListener("input", function () { setDirty(true); immMeta(); });
  qs("#appContent").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".ol-pri, .ol-caret, .ol-foldn, .ol-check, .ol-tag, #olIndent, #olOutdent, #olUp, #olDown, #olAdd, #mmAdd, #mmDel, #mmOrder, [data-md]")) {
      setDirty(true); immMeta();
    }
  });
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("focusin", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input");
    if (ta && imm.on) setTimeout(function () { centerRow(ta); }, 0);
  });
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("keyup", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input");
    if (ta && imm.on) centerRow(ta);
  });
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("input", function () { if (imm.on) centerCaret(); });
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("keyup", function () { if (imm.on) centerCaret(); });
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("click", function () { if (imm.on) centerCaret(); });

  /* ============================================================
     启动
     ============================================================ */
  (async function boot() {
    var r = await API.fetchNotes();
    state.notes = r.data.slice();

    /* 嵌入模式：doc= 把文档过滤器选到该书（等价于用户自己在 #docFilter 选中它）。
       新笔记的归属不用另改 —— 既有的 curDocId() 在无打开笔记时就是 state.doc 优先。
       该书若不在页面选项里（用户导入、DB.shelf 之外的文档），嵌入态补一条选项。 */
    if (EMBED && embedBook) {
      var sel = qs("#docFilter");
      var hasOpt = Array.prototype.some.call(sel.options, function (o) { return o.value === embedDocId; });
      if (!hasOpt) {
        var op = document.createElement("option");
        op.value = embedDocId;
        op.textContent = embedBook.title;
        sel.appendChild(op);
      }
      state.doc = embedDocId;
      sel.value = embedDocId;
    }

    renderList();

    var deep = params.get("note");
    if (deep && state.notes.some(function (n) { return n.id === deep; })) {
      openNote(deep);
      setTimeout(function () {
        var row = qs('#notesList .note-row[data-note="' + deep + '"]');
        if (row) row.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
      }, 120);
    } else {
      /* 嵌入态优先开该书自己的第一条；普通态维持原逻辑（最新一条） */
      var first = (EMBED && embedBook)
        ? (state.notes.find(function (n) { return n.docId === embedDocId; }) || null)
        : null;
      if (!first) first = state.notes[0] || null;
      if (first) openNote(first.id);
      else {
        state.tree = [newNode(0, "")];
        setView("outline");
        renderList();
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      if (state.view === "mindmap") { fitMind(); renderMind(); }
    });

    /* ============================================================
       v2.23 W6.3 · 工作台高度预算去魔数（问题六.1）
       styles.css 里 --work-h-max = calc(100dvh - 46px - 184px)，那 184 是把
       「页头 + 上下留白」一次估死。实测它根本不是一个常数：
         1280 宽 顶边 172 + 下内距 54 = 226（估 230，差 4）
          768 宽 顶边 230 + 下内距 48 = 278（估 230，少算 48 → 卡片比可用空间高 48）
          390 宽 顶边 243 + 30 + 底部标签栏预留 74 = 347（估 230，少算 117 → 压进标签栏）
       改为现场量：顶边到视口顶的距离 + 容器下方该留的内边距（含 ≤600 的标签栏预留）。
       嵌窗(html.embed) 与沉浸(body.nw) 另有自己的高度口径（notes.html 顶部 / body.nw），不参与。
       ============================================================ */
    (function workBudget() {
      var lay = qs(".work-layout");
      if (!lay) return;
      function set() {
        var de = document.documentElement, bd = document.body;
        if (de.classList.contains("embed") || bd.classList.contains("nw") || bd.classList.contains("immersive")) return;
        var ac = qs("#appContent");
        var pg = lay.closest(".page") || lay;
        /* rect.top 是视口相对值：外层已滚动时它会变小，量出的预算虚高，补回 scrollTop */
        var top = lay.getBoundingClientRect().top + (ac ? ac.scrollTop : 0);
        var pad = (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(pg).paddingBottom) || 0)
          + (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ac || pg).paddingBottom) || 0);
        var h = Math.round(window.innerHeight - top - pad);
        if (h > 240) lay.style.setProperty("--work-h-max", h + "px");
      }
      set();
      /* 页头换行 / 副标题加长 / 字体加载完（29 套主题各自换字体，度量会变）都会挪顶边 */
      if (typeof ResizeObserver === "function" && qs(".page-head")) {
        new ResizeObserver(set).observe(qs(".page-head"));
      }
      window.addEventListener("resize", set);
      if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(set);
    })();
  })();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
````

### ◆ 位置：`ink-reader/cards.html`（1459 行 / 76.1 KB）— 闪卡复习：调度、正面/背面、编辑

````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN" data-theme="paper">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<script>try{var D=document.documentElement,S=sessionStorage;if(S.getItem("inkread.boot.v1"))D.classList.add("boot-skip");if(S.getItem("inkread.nav.v1")){S.removeItem("inkread.nav.v1");D.classList.add("nav-in")}try{var V=new CSSStyleSheet();V.replaceSync("@view-transition{navigation:auto}");if(V.cssRules.length)D.classList.add("vt")}catch(v){}if(D.classList.contains("nav-in")&&D.classList.contains("vt")){var K=document.createElement("i");K.className="nav-seal-live";K.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");K.textContent="墨";D.appendChild(K);setTimeout(function(){K.remove()},900)}}catch(e){}</script>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>墨读 InkRead · 闪卡</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:,">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="fonts/local.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="tokens.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
<style>
/* ---------- 闪卡页（v2.6 要求四）----------
   只写本页专属的两块：① 按类别陈列的卡组列表；② 页内全屏复习浮层。
   卡面 / 评分排 / 挖空 一律沿用 styles.css 既有 .fc-* 全局样式
   （与阅读页闪卡面板同一套外观，观感同源，也不重复造样式）。 */

/* 页头统计：与 tasks.html 的 chip 统计同一做法 */
.cards-stats { display: flex; gap: var(--space-8); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cards-stats b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* ---------- 一、类别分组 + 卡组 ---------- */
.cat-block { margin-bottom: var(--space-26); }
.cat-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-9); margin-bottom: var(--space-12); }
.cat-head h2 { font-size: var(--fs-15); letter-spacing: .12em; font-weight: 700; }
.cat-head .ic { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.cat-head .cat-n { font-size: var(--fs-11_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .06em; }
.cat-head .cat-rule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--line-2); }

.deck-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(292px, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-14); align-items: start; }
.deck-item { min-width: 0; }
/* 展开详情时占满整行：卡组列表重新排布，详情不被挤成窄条 */
.deck-item.open { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.deck-card { position: relative; padding: var(--space-15) var(--space-17) var(--space-14); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); }
.dc-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-8); }
.dc-name { font-size: var(--fs-16); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; margin: var(--space-10) 0 var(--space-6); cursor: pointer; }
.dc-name:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.dc-meta { font-size: var(--fs-12_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .03em; }
.dc-meta b { color: var(--accent-ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.dc-bar { margin: var(--space-11) 0 var(--space-13); }
.dc-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-8); }

/* ⋯ 菜单：卡组操作（重命名 / 删除） */
.dc-more { flex: none; }
.dc-menu {
  position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50px; z-index: 6; min-width: 208px; padding: var(--space-6);
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-md); animation: dcMenuIn .16s ease both;
}
@keyframes dcMenuIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-3px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.dc-mi {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-8); width: 100%; padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-10);
  background: none; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-xs);
  color: var(--ink-2); font-size: var(--fs-13); letter-spacing: .03em; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
}
.dc-mi:hover { background: var(--paper-2); color: var(--ink); }
.dc-mi.danger { color: var(--amber-ink); }
/* 第二击确认：按钮改为醒目的警示态 */
.dc-mi.confirm { background: var(--amber-wash); color: var(--amber-ink); border: 1px solid var(--amber); }
.dc-warn { margin-top: var(--space-4); padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-10) var(--space-4); border-top: 1px solid var(--line-2); font-size: var(--fs-11); color: var(--ink-3); line-height: 1.7; }

/* 行内重命名 */
.dc-rename { display: flex; gap: var(--space-6); margin: var(--space-10) 0 var(--space-6); }
.dc-rename .field { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

/* ---------- 二、卡组详情：组内卡列表 ---------- */
.deck-detail { margin-top: var(--space-14); padding-top: var(--space-13); border-top: 1px solid var(--line-2); }
.detail-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-10); flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: var(--space-11); }
.detail-head .dh-k { font-size: var(--fs-11_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .06em; }
.detail-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-8); max-height: 54vh; overflow-y: auto; }
/* 行内卡面：点文本在「正面（挖空）⇄ 背面（原文）」之间翻，不跳页 */
.dk-main { cursor: pointer; }
.dk-main:hover .dk-front, .dk-main:hover .dk-back { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.dk-back { font-size: var(--fs-13); color: var(--ink); }
.dk-flip-tip { font-size: var(--fs-10_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .05em; }

/* ---------- 三、复习浮层：页内全屏，风格同阅读页闪卡面板 ---------- */
.fc-stage { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 280; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--paper); background-image: var(--grain); }
.fcs-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-12); padding: var(--space-13) var(--space-18); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-2); }
.fcs-name { font-size: var(--fs-14); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.fcs-prog { margin-left: auto; font-size: var(--fs-12_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .06em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.fcs-body {
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; width: 100%; max-width: 940px; margin: 0 auto;
  padding: var(--space-22) clamp(var(--space-16), 6vw, 90px) var(--space-28);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 0;
}
.fcs-key { margin-top: var(--space-14); text-align: center; font-size: var(--fs-11_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .05em; }
.fcs-key kbd { font: inherit; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-4); padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-5); margin: 0 var(--space-2); background: var(--paper-2); }
/* 完成小结 */
.fcs-sum { text-align: center; padding: var(--space-20) 0; }
/* v2.23 §W3 第六步：页内 <style> 里写死的 .ic 尺寸一并收进五档 token（本卡三处 + index 三处 + reader 一处）。
   这一步不是审美统一 —— CSS 的 width/height 会盖掉 <svg> 上的属性值，所以这里的 13/11/22/34
   是**真正生效**的尺寸，工厂 iconSize() 的档位换算对它们完全无效。对不上档的一律往小收
   （闸 K8 扫源码、K9 量真实渲染值）。 */
.fcs-sum .ic { width: var(--ic-xl); height: var(--ic-xl); color: var(--accent-ink); margin-bottom: var(--space-12); }
.fcs-sum .big { font-size: var(--fs-26); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; }
.fcs-sum .card-note { margin-top: var(--space-10); }

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .deck-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .dc-menu { right: 8px; left: 8px; min-width: 0; }
  .fcs-body { padding: var(--space-16) var(--space-16) var(--space-22); }
}

/* 已删除的卡组：恢复入口（删除只清调度，高亮还在 —— 一键重新成卡） */
.gone-strip {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-10); flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: var(--space-6); padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-15);
  border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--paper-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-12_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .02em;
}
.gone-strip .ic { color: var(--ink-3); }
.gone-strip .chip-btn { background: var(--paper); }
.gone-strip .chip-btn em { font-style: normal; color: var(--ink-3); }

/* ============================================================
   四、v2.10 信息架构：工具条 + 筛选侧栏 + 卡片 / 紧凑列表双视图
   —— 侧栏是「检索语法的可视化快捷输入」，与检索框共用同一个查询：
      点一下即改检索框里的字，命中数随之实时更新（Anki 式双通道）。
   ============================================================ */
.cards-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-10); flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0 0 var(--space-14); }
.q-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; flex: 1 1 300px; min-width: 200px; }
.q-wrap .q-ic { position: absolute; left: 10px; color: var(--ink-3); display: flex; pointer-events: none; }
.q-input {
  width: 100%; padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-30) var(--space-8) var(--space-32); font-size: var(--fs-13_5);
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm); color: var(--ink);
}
.q-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); }
.q-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink-2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-wash); }
.q-clear { position: absolute; right: 5px; display: flex; padding: var(--space-4); background: none; border: none; color: var(--ink-3); cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--r-xs); }
.q-clear:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.q-hit { font-size: var(--fs-12); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .04em; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.q-err {
  flex: 1 1 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-8); margin-top: var(--space-2);
  padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12); border: 1px solid var(--amber); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: var(--amber-wash); color: var(--amber-ink); font-size: var(--fs-12_5); letter-spacing: .02em;
}
.q-sort {
  padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-10); font-size: var(--fs-12_5); color: var(--ink-2);
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer;
}
.save-box { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-6); }

.cards-main { display: flex; gap: var(--space-20); align-items: flex-start; }
.cards-side { flex: 0 0 224px; width: 224px; position: sticky; top: 12px; max-height: calc(100vh - 96px); overflow-y: auto; }
.cards-main.side-off .cards-side { display: none; }
.cards-content { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }

.side-sec { margin-bottom: var(--space-18); }
.side-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-7); margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
  font-size: var(--fs-11); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .14em;
}
.side-head .ic { width: var(--ic-xs); height: var(--ic-xs); }
.si-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.si-n { font-size: var(--fs-11_5); color: var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; flex: none; }
.si-x { flex: none; display: flex; padding: var(--space-2); border-radius: var(--r-xs); color: var(--ink-3); background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; }
.si-x:hover { color: var(--amber-ink); background: var(--amber-wash); }
.side-empty { font-size: var(--fs-12); color: var(--ink-3); line-height: 1.7; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4); }
.side-filter {
  width: 100%; margin-bottom: var(--space-6); padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-9); font-size: var(--fs-12_5);
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-xs); color: var(--ink);
}
.side-doc .si-n b { color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 600; }

/* 紧凑列表视图：一行一卡组，密度约为卡片视图的 3 倍 */
.deck-list { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden; }
.deck-row {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-12); flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-12); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--paper);
}
.deck-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.deck-row:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.dr-namebtn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-7); flex: 1 1 200px; min-width: 0; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: var(--fs-13_5); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
.dr-namebtn .ic { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.dr-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.dr-namebtn:hover .dr-name { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.dr-cat { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: var(--fs-11_5); color: var(--ink-3); letter-spacing: .06em; }
.dr-num { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-4); font-size: var(--fs-12); color: var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.dr-num b { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.dr-recent { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-4); font-size: var(--fs-11_5); color: var(--ink-3); }
.deck-row .dc-menu { top: calc(100% + 2px); right: 8px; }
.deck-row .deck-detail { flex: 1 1 100%; width: 100%; margin: var(--space-8) 0 var(--space-2); padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-4) var(--space-4); }

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .cards-main { flex-direction: column; }
  .cards-side { position: static; width: 100%; flex: 1 1 auto; max-height: none; }
  .dr-cat, .dr-recent { display: none; }
}
</style>
<script src="ink-keys.js"></script>
<script src="fonts.js"></script>
<script src="theme.js"></script>
</head>
<body data-page="cards">
  <a class="skip-link" href="#appContent">跳到主内容</a>
<div class="boot" id="boot" aria-hidden="true">
  <span class="boot-seal">墨</span>
  <span class="boot-name">墨读 InkRead</span>
  <span class="boot-line"></span>
</div>
<div class="device">
  <div class="screen" id="screen">
    <main class="app-content" id="appContent" tabindex="-1">
      <div class="page">
        <div class="page-head">
          <div class="ph-main">
            <h1 class="page-title">闪卡</h1>
            <span class="ph-sub" id="cardsSub">从高亮自动成卡 · 按遗忘曲线复习</span>
          </div>
          <div class="ph-actions cards-stats" id="cardsStats"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="rule-2line" aria-hidden="true"></div>

        <!-- 工具条：图形（侧栏 / 视图 / 排序）与文本（检索框）双通道共用同一个查询 -->
        <div class="cards-toolbar" id="cardsToolbar">
          <div class="q-wrap">
            <span class="q-ic" id="icQ"></span>
            <input id="q" class="q-input" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"
                   placeholder='检索：kind:paper / is:due / doc:书名 / "短语" / -词 / ( ) / or'
                   aria-label="检索闪卡">
            <button class="q-clear" id="qClear" type="button" title="清空检索" aria-label="清空检索"></button>
          </div>
          <span class="q-hit" id="qHit" aria-live="polite"></span>
          <div class="view-seg" role="group" aria-label="视图切换">
            <button type="button" data-view="grid" title="卡片视图" aria-label="卡片视图"></button>
            <button type="button" data-view="list" title="紧凑列表" aria-label="紧凑列表"></button>
          </div>
          <select class="q-sort" id="sortSel" aria-label="排序方式"></select>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="saveQ" type="button" title="保存检索" aria-label="保存检索"></button>
          <span class="save-box" id="saveBox" hidden>
            <input class="field" id="saveName" type="text" placeholder="检索名称" aria-label="检索名称">
            <button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" id="saveOk" type="button">保存</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="saveCancel" type="button">取消</button>
          </span>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="sideToggle" type="button" title="折叠 / 展开筛选侧栏" aria-label="折叠或展开筛选侧栏"></button>
          <div class="q-err" id="qErr" hidden role="alert"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="cards-main" id="cardsMain">
          <aside class="cards-side" id="cardsSide" aria-label="筛选侧栏"></aside>
          <div class="cards-content" id="cardsBody"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>

    <!-- 复习浮层：页内全屏（absolute 于 .screen 内，盖住底部标签栏），初始隐藏 -->
    <div class="fc-stage" id="fcStage" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="复习闪卡">
      <div class="fcs-top">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="fcsExit"><span id="icExit"></span>退出复习</button>
        <span class="fcs-name" id="fcsName"></span>
        <span class="fcs-prog" id="fcsProg"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="fcs-body" id="fcsBody"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="toast-root" id="toastRoot" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"></div>
<script src="srs.js"></script>
<script src="mock.js"></script>
<script src="api.js"></script>
<script src="app.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* 存储键（与 api.js / modes.js 同一套语义，不新增旁路）
     · inkread.cards.v1 —— SRS 调度：{noteId: {ef, ivl, reps, due, last, suspended}}
       读：API.fetchCards()；写单卡：API.saveCard(id, st)（与阅读页闪卡面板同一条通路）；
       删除整组调度：api.js 没有删除端点，本页按同一形状直接覆盖写这个键（见 dropDeckCards）。
     · inkread.decks.v1 —— 卡组自定义名：{docId: name}（本页独有，无历史数据，缺省 {}）。
     · inkread.cards.gone.v1 —— 「删除卡组」的墓碑：{docId: {at, n}}。
       为什么需要第三个键：卡是由高亮派生出来的，删掉调度记录后高亮还在，
       下一帧又会重新成组 —— 与「删除后该组消失」不符，也不符合确认文案里
       「高亮与笔记不受影响」的承诺（源数据只读，删的是派生视图）。
       墓碑只记「这篇文档暂不成卡」，两个正式键的形状因此保持不变
       （cards.v1 始终是 {noteId:{…}}，decks.v1 始终是 {docId:name}）；
       页面底部给出「重新成卡」入口，一键把墓碑摘掉即恢复。
     · inkread.cards.ui.v1 —— v2.10 视图偏好：{view, sort, side, openDecks}。
     · inkread.cards.search.v1 —— v2.10 保存的检索：[{name, q, at}]（最多 20，先进先出）。
       两个 v1 都是本页新增、无历史数据，一律 try/catch + 缺省兜底。 */
  var K_DECKS = "inkread.decks.v1";
  var K_CARDS = "inkread.cards.v1";
  var K_GONE = "inkread.cards.gone.v1";
  var K_UI = "inkread.cards.ui.v1";
  var K_SEARCH = "inkread.cards.search.v1";

  /* ============================================================
     一、闪卡调度纯函数：单一事实源 srs.js
     —— 原先这里逐字复制了 modes.js 的 ymd / isDueSt / isSusp / sm2Update /
        RATE / makeCloze，注释写着「改一处需两处同步」；v2.10 抽到 srs.js，
        两个页面都只引用 window.InkSRS。此处保留同名局部别名，
        让下方调用点一行不改。srs.js 在 mock.js 之前按依赖顺序引入。
     ============================================================ */
  var InkSRS = window.InkSRS;
  var ymd = InkSRS.ymd;
  var isDueSt = InkSRS.isDueSt;
  var isSusp = InkSRS.isSusp;
  var sm2Update = InkSRS.sm2Update;
  var RATE = InkSRS.RATE;
  var makeCloze = InkSRS.makeCloze;

  /* ============================================================
     二、类别映射（v2.6 要求三的 8 类体系）
     —— 只做展示映射：未知 / 缺失的 key 原样显示该值（兜底不静默吞掉），
        排在已知八类之后；类别顺序与方案文档的表格一致。
     ============================================================ */
  var CAT_ORDER = ["book", "textbook", "paper", "report", "plan", "note", "comic", "other"];
  var CAT = {
    book: { name: "书籍", icon: "book" },
    textbook: { name: "教材", icon: "book-marked" },
    paper: { name: "论文", icon: "graduation-cap" },
    report: { name: "报告", icon: "clipboard-check" },
    plan: { name: "计划", icon: "list-checks" },
    note: { name: "笔记", icon: "notebook-pen" },
    comic: { name: "漫画", icon: "image" },
    other: { name: "其他", icon: "layers" }
  };
  function catRank(t) { var i = CAT_ORDER.indexOf(t); return i < 0 ? CAT_ORDER.length : i; }
  function catName(t) { return (CAT[t] || {}).name || String(t); }          /* 缺 key → 原值 */
  function catIcon(t) { return (CAT[t] || {}).icon || "layers"; }

  /* ============================================================
     三、数据聚合：书架 × 笔记 × 调度
     卡源口径与阅读页 poolAll 完全一致：
     kind ∈ {highlight, margin} 且 text 长度 ≥ 8 字（modes.js 的 poolAll）。
     ============================================================ */
  function readDecks() {
    try {
      var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K_DECKS));
      return v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : {};
    } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function writeDecks(m) { try { localStorage.setItem(K_DECKS, JSON.stringify(m)); } catch (e) {} }
  function readGone() {
    try {
      var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K_GONE));
      return v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : {};
    } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function writeGone(m) { try { localStorage.setItem(K_GONE, JSON.stringify(m)); } catch (e) {} }
  /* 整表覆盖写 cards.v1：删除卡组时要把一批 key 摘掉，逐张 saveCard 做不到 */
  function writeCardsAll(m) { try { localStorage.setItem(K_CARDS, JSON.stringify(m)); } catch (e) {} }

  /* ---------- 视图偏好 / 保存的检索：读取一律 try/catch + 缺省兜底 ---------- */
  var UI_DEF = { view: "grid", sort: "due", side: true, openDecks: [] };
  function readUI() {
    try {
      var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K_UI));
      if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return copyUI(UI_DEF);
      return {
        view: v.view === "list" ? "list" : "grid",
        sort: ["due", "name", "cards", "recent"].indexOf(v.sort) >= 0 ? v.sort : "due",
        side: v.side === false ? false : true,
        openDecks: Array.isArray(v.openDecks) ? v.openDecks.slice(0, 200) : []
      };
    } catch (e) { return copyUI(UI_DEF); }
  }
  function copyUI(o) { return { view: o.view, sort: o.sort, side: o.side, openDecks: (o.openDecks || []).slice() }; }
  function writeUI() { try { localStorage.setItem(K_UI, JSON.stringify(state.ui)); } catch (e) {} }

  function readSaved() {
    try {
      var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K_SEARCH));
      if (!Array.isArray(v)) return [];
      return v.filter(function (x) { return x && typeof x.q === "string"; }).slice(0, 20);
    } catch (e) { return []; }
  }
  function writeSaved(list) { try { localStorage.setItem(K_SEARCH, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch (e) {} }

  var state = {
    cards: {},        /* inkread.cards.v1 的内存副本 */
    decks: {},        /* inkread.decks.v1 的内存副本 */
    gone: {},         /* inkread.cards.gone.v1 的内存副本（已删除的卡组） */
    ui: readUI(),     /* v2.10 视图偏好 */
    saved: readSaved(), /* v2.10 保存的检索 */
    q: "",            /* 当前检索串（侧栏与检索框共用同一份） */
    res: [],          /* 当前查询下的有效结果（解析失败时保留上一次的） */
    allCount: 0,      /* 未过滤的卡组数（区分「真的没卡」与「没匹配」） */
    err: null,        /* 检索解析失败的人话提示 */
    menu: null,       /* 打开 ⋯ 菜单的 docId */
    renaming: null,   /* 正在重命名的 docId */
    confirmDel: null, /* 删除按钮已点第一击的 docId（第二击才真删） */
    rv: null          /* 复习会话 */
  };
  function isOpen(id) { return state.ui.openDecks.indexOf(id) >= 0; }
  function toggleOpen(id) {
    var i = state.ui.openDecks.indexOf(id);
    if (i >= 0) state.ui.openDecks.splice(i, 1); else state.ui.openDecks.push(id);
    writeUI();
  }

  /* 卡源口径 = srs.js 的 poolOf（≥8 字 + kind 过滤 + 同文去重），与阅读页 poolAll 同一份定义。
     去重后同文高亮只留第一张：同一句话划两次不该背两遍；被并掉的条数在页脚如实报告。 */
  var dupN = 0;
  function cardSources(notes) {
    var p = InkSRS.poolOf(notes || []);
    dupN = p.dup;
    return p.list;
  }

  /* 遍历书架 → 每本书取其笔记里的成卡源 → 组装卡组 —— 阅读页 poolAll 同口径 */
  function buildDecks() {
    var shelf = InkStore.getShelf() || [];
    var notes = InkStore.getNotes() || [];
    var byDoc = {};
    cardSources(notes).forEach(function (n) {
      var id = n.docId || "";
      (byDoc[id] || (byDoc[id] = [])).push(n);
    });

    function makeDeck(docId, title, type, list) {
      var cards = list.map(function (n) {
