        var st = state.cards[n.id] || null;
        var excl = !!(st && st.excluded);
        /* 排除＝「这条高亮不该成卡」：与挂起（这轮先放着）分开计，都不进复习队列 */
        return { n: n, st: st, susp: isSusp(st), excl: excl, due: !isSusp(st) && !excl && isDueSt(st) };
      });
      /* 列表顺序：待复习 → 新卡 → 已排期 → 挂起 → 已排除；同档按页码 */
      cards.sort(function (a, b) {
        var ra = a.excl ? 4 : a.susp ? 3 : a.due ? 0 : (a.st && a.st.due ? 2 : 1);
        var rb = b.excl ? 4 : b.susp ? 3 : b.due ? 0 : (b.st && b.st.due ? 2 : 1);
        return ra - rb || (a.n.page || 0) - (b.n.page || 0);
      });
      var dueN = cards.filter(function (c) { return c.due; }).length;
      var suspN = cards.filter(function (c) { return c.susp && !c.excl; }).length;
      var exclN = cards.filter(function (c) { return c.excl; }).length;
      var custom = state.decks[docId];
      /* 文档已不在书架（被删除 / 导入残留）时不许只写「未知文档」：既说不清是哪一本，
         也让人怀疑程序坏了。带上 docId 前 6 位，几本孤儿卡组彼此才分得开。 */
      var orphans = "未收录文档 · #" + String(docId || "").slice(0, 6);
      return {
        docId: docId, type: type || "other",
        bookTitle: title || orphans,
        name: (custom && String(custom).trim()) || title || orphans,
        custom: !!(custom && String(custom).trim()),
        cards: cards, totalN: cards.length, dueN: dueN, suspN: suspN, exclN: exclN,
        liveN: cards.length - suspN - exclN
      };
    }

    var decks = [], seen = {};
    shelf.forEach(function (d) {
      seen[d.id] = 1;
      var list = byDoc[d.id];
      if (!list || !list.length) return;      /* 没有成卡源的书不出现 */
      if (state.gone[d.id]) return;           /* 已删除的卡组：墓碑在就不重新成组（高亮仍在） */
      decks.push(makeDeck(d.id, d.title, d.type, list));
    });
    /* 笔记所属文档已不在书架（被删除 / 导入残留）：也成组，归入「其他」，名字可清 */
    Object.keys(byDoc).forEach(function (docId) {
      if (seen[docId] || !byDoc[docId].length || state.gone[docId]) return;
      decks.push(makeDeck(docId, "", "other", byDoc[docId]));
    });
    return decks;
  }

  /* 墓碑对应的文档（还有笔记在的才列出来，可一键重新成卡） */
  function goneList() {
    var notes = InkStore.getNotes() || [];
    var nByDoc = {};
    cardSources(notes).forEach(function (n) { nByDoc[n.docId || ""] = (nByDoc[n.docId || ""] || 0) + 1; });
    return Object.keys(state.gone).filter(function (docId) { return nByDoc[docId]; }).map(function (docId) {
      var doc = null;
      (InkStore.getShelf() || []).forEach(function (d) { if (d.id === docId) doc = d; });
      var custom = state.decks[docId];
      var g = state.gone[docId] || {};
      return { docId: docId, n: nByDoc[docId],
        name: (custom && String(custom).trim()) || (doc && doc.title) || g.t ||
              "未收录文档 · #" + String(docId).slice(0, 6) };
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     四、Anki-lite 检索语法（自写解析器，不引库）
     BNF（大小写不敏感；顶层默认 AND）：
       query   := andExpr ( 'or' andExpr )*
       andExpr := unary+                         # 隐式 AND
       unary   := '-' atom | atom
       atom    := '(' query ')' | term
       term    := 'kind:' <8 类之一> | 'is:' due|new|sched|susp
                | 'doc:' <名称片段> | '"短语"' | <普通关键词>
     同维度正项在 AND 内合并为 OR（kind:paper kind:plan = 论文 或 计划）。
     解析失败给人话提示，且保留上一次的有效结果（不清空列表）。
     ============================================================ */
  var IS_VALUES = ["due", "new", "sched", "susp", "excl"];

  function lex(s) {
    var toks = [], i = 0, n = s.length;
    while (i < n) {
      var c = s.charAt(i);
      if (c === " " || c === "\t" || c === "\n") { i++; continue; }
      if (c === "(" || c === ")") { toks.push({ t: c }); i++; continue; }
      if (c === "-") { toks.push({ t: "-" }); i++; continue; }
      var buf = "";
      while (i < n) {
        c = s.charAt(i);
        if (c === " " || c === "\t" || c === "\n" || c === "(" || c === ")") break;
        if (c === '"') {                       /* 引号：保留空格，构成「精确短语」 */
          var j = s.indexOf('"', i + 1);
          if (j < 0) throw { msg: "引号没有闭合：" + s.slice(i) };
          buf += s.slice(i + 1, j);
          i = j + 1;
        } else { buf += c; i++; }
      }
      if (buf) toks.push({ t: "word", v: buf });
    }
    return toks;
  }

  function termFromWord(w) {
    var i = w.indexOf(":");
    if (i > 0) {
      var f = w.slice(0, i).toLowerCase(), v = w.slice(i + 1);
      if (f === "kind") {
        if (CAT_ORDER.indexOf(v.toLowerCase()) < 0) throw { msg: "不认识的类别 kind:" + v + "（可用：" + CAT_ORDER.join(" / ") + "）" };
        return { op: "term", field: "kind", value: v.toLowerCase() };
      }
      if (f === "is") {
        if (IS_VALUES.indexOf(v.toLowerCase()) < 0) throw { msg: "不认识的状态 is:" + v + "（可用：" + IS_VALUES.join(" / ") + "）" };
        return { op: "term", field: "is", value: v.toLowerCase() };
      }
      if (f === "doc") {
        if (!v) throw { msg: "doc: 后面缺少文档名" };
        return { op: "term", field: "doc", value: v };
      }
      throw { msg: "不认识的维度「" + f + ":」（本页支持 kind: / is: / doc:）" };
    }
    if (!w) throw { msg: "空条件" };
    return { op: "term", field: "text", value: w };
  }

  function combineAnd(list) {
    var groups = { kind: [], is: [], doc: [], text: [] }, others = [];
    list.forEach(function (n) { if (n && n.op === "term") groups[n.field].push(n); else others.push(n); });
    var parts = [];
    ["kind", "is", "doc", "text"].forEach(function (f) {
      var g = groups[f];
      if (g.length === 1) parts.push(g[0]);
      else if (g.length > 1) {                 /* 同维度正项 → OR（Anki：kind:a kind:b = a 或 b） */
        var node = g[0];
        for (var i = 1; i < g.length; i++) node = { op: "or", a: node, b: g[i] };
        parts.push(node);
      }
    });
    others.forEach(function (n) { parts.push(n); });
    var out = null;
    parts.forEach(function (p) { out = out ? { op: "and", a: out, b: p } : p; });
    return out;
  }

  function parse(s) {
    var toks = lex(s), pos = 0;
    function peek() { return toks[pos]; }
    function next() { return toks[pos++]; }
    function isOr(t) { return t && t.t === "word" && t.v.toLowerCase() === "or"; }
    function parseOr() {
      var left = parseAnd();
      while (isOr(peek())) { next(); left = { op: "or", a: left, b: parseAnd() }; }
      return left;
    }
    function parseAnd() {
      var list = [];
      while (peek() && peek().t !== ")" && !isOr(peek())) list.push(parseUnary());
      if (!list.length) throw { msg: "表达式不完整" };
      return combineAnd(list);
    }
    function parseUnary() {
      if (peek() && peek().t === "-") { next(); return { op: "not", a: parseAtom() }; }
      return parseAtom();
    }
    function parseAtom() {
      var t = peek();
      if (!t) throw { msg: "表达式不完整" };
      if (t.t === "(") { next(); var e = parseOr(); if (!peek() || peek().t !== ")") throw { msg: "括号没有闭合" }; next(); return e; }
      if (t.t === ")") throw { msg: "多余的右括号" };
      if (t.t === "-") throw { msg: "多余的 -" };
      next();
      if (isOr(t)) throw { msg: "or 两侧缺少条件" };
      return termFromWord(t.v);
    }
    var ast = parseOr();
    if (pos < toks.length) {
      var r = toks[pos];
      throw { msg: r.t === ")" ? "多余的右括号" : "看不懂的记号「" + (r.v || r.t) + "」" };
    }
    return ast;
  }

  function parseQuery(q) {
    var s = String(q == null ? "" : q).trim();
    if (!s) return { ast: null, error: null };
    try { return { ast: parse(s), error: null }; }
    catch (e) { return { ast: null, error: (e && e.msg) || String(e) }; }
  }

  function matchTerm(ctx, t) {
    var n = ctx.note, d = ctx.deck, c = ctx.card;
    if (t.field === "text") {
      var hay = String(n.text || "") + " " + String(n.body || "") + " " + String(n.title || "");
      return hay.toLowerCase().indexOf(String(t.value).toLowerCase()) >= 0;
    }
    if (t.field === "kind") return d.type === t.value;
    if (t.field === "doc") return (d.name + " " + d.bookTitle).toLowerCase().indexOf(String(t.value).toLowerCase()) >= 0;
    if (t.field === "is") {
      if (t.value === "due") return !!c.due;
      if (t.value === "susp") return !!c.susp && !c.excl;
      if (t.value === "excl") return !!c.excl;
      if (t.value === "new") return !c.susp && !c.excl && (!c.st || !c.st.reps);
      if (t.value === "sched") return !c.susp && !c.excl && !!(c.st && c.st.due && c.st.due > ymd());
    }
    return false;
  }
  function matchCard(ctx, node) {
    if (!node) return true;
    if (node.op === "and") return matchCard(ctx, node.a) && matchCard(ctx, node.b);
    if (node.op === "or") return matchCard(ctx, node.a) || matchCard(ctx, node.b);
    if (node.op === "not") return !matchCard(ctx, node.a);
    if (node.op === "term") return matchTerm(ctx, node);
    return true;
  }

  /* 过滤到「卡」这一层：保留仍命中的卡，重算计数，空卡组丢弃 */
  function applyQuery(decks, ast) {
    if (!ast) return decks;
    var out = [];
    decks.forEach(function (d) {
      var cards = [], dueN = 0, suspN = 0, exclN = 0;
      d.cards.forEach(function (c) {
        if (!matchCard({ deck: d, card: c, note: c.n }, ast)) return;
        cards.push(c);
        if (c.due) dueN++;
        if (c.susp && !c.excl) suspN++;
        if (c.excl) exclN++;
      });
      if (!cards.length) return;
      var copy = {}, k;
      for (k in d) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(d, k)) copy[k] = d[k];
      copy.cards = cards; copy.totalN = cards.length; copy.dueN = dueN; copy.suspN = suspN;
      copy.exclN = exclN; copy.liveN = cards.length - suspN - exclN;
      out.push(copy);
    });
    return out;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     五、侧栏 = 检索语法的可视化快捷输入（与检索框共用同一个查询）
     修饰键语义（Anki）：点击＝替换同类条件；Ctrl＝AND 追加；
     Shift＝OR 追加；Alt＝取反。改的是检索框里的字，不是另一套状态。
     ============================================================ */
  function reEsc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"); }
  function hasToken(q, token) {
    if (!q) return false;
    return new RegExp("(^|\\s)" + reEsc(token) + "(?=\\s|$)").test(q);
  }
  function stripDim(q, dim) {
    if (!q) return "";
    var re = new RegExp("(^|\\s)-?" + dim + ":(?:\"[^\"]*\"|[^\\s()]+)", "g");
    return q.replace(re, function (m, sp) { return sp; }).replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();
  }
  function joinStr(a, b) { return (a && b) ? a + " " + b : (a || b); }
  function applySide(dim, token, mode) {
    var q = String(state.q || "").trim();
    if (mode === "shift") state.q = q ? q + " or " + token : token;
    else if (mode === "alt") state.q = joinStr(q, "-" + token);
    else if (mode === "ctrl") state.q = joinStr(q, token);
    else {                                   /* 单击：替换同类条件；再点同一个＝取消 */
      var base = stripDim(q, dim);
      state.q = hasToken(q, token) ? base : joinStr(base, token);
    }
    syncQInput();
    render();
  }
  function syncQInput() { qs("#q").value = state.q; }
  function stamp() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " "); }

  /* ============================================================
     六、渲染
     ============================================================ */
  function render() {
    var all = buildDecks();
    state.allCount = all.length;
    var parsed = parseQuery(state.q);
    if (parsed.error) {
      state.err = parsed.error;              /* 解析失败：保留上一次的有效结果 */
    } else {
      state.err = null;
      state.res = applyQuery(all, parsed.ast);
    }
    renderHead(all);
    renderToolbarState();
    renderSide(state.res);
    renderBody(state.res);
  }

  function sumBy(decks, f) { var s = 0; decks.forEach(function (d) { s += f(d) || 0; }); return s; }
  function newCount(decks) {
    var n = 0;
    decks.forEach(function (d) { d.cards.forEach(function (c) { if (!c.susp && !c.excl && (!c.st || !c.st.reps)) n++; }); });
    return n;
  }

  function renderHead(decks) {
    var due = sumBy(decks, function (d) { return d.dueN; });
    qs("#cardsSub").textContent = "从高亮自动成卡 · 按遗忘曲线复习 · 共 " + decks.length + " 个卡组" +
      (dupN ? " · 已并入 " + dupN + " 条同文高亮" : "");
    /* v2.17：页头原本五个计数 pill 横排 578px，其中四个与左栏「状态」分组逐字重复
       （到期/新卡/已挂起），页头于是变成了第二条侧栏。只留「今日到期」——
       它是唯一决定「现在要不要复习」的数，其余口径留在侧栏（那里可点、可筛）。 */
    qs("#cardsStats").innerHTML = [
      { k: "今日到期", v: due, i: "calendar-days" }
    ].map(function (c) {
      return '<span class="chip">' + icon(c.i, 14) + c.k + "　<b>" + c.v + "</b></span>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderToolbarState() {
    var hit = sumBy(state.res, function (d) { return d.totalN; });
    qs("#qHit").textContent = "命中 " + hit + " 张卡 · " + state.res.length + " 个卡组";
    var box = qs("#qErr");
    if (state.err) {
      box.hidden = false;
      box.innerHTML = icon("alert-triangle", 14) + "<span>看不懂这段检索：<b>" + esc(state.err) + "</b> · 已保留上一次的有效结果</span>";
    } else {
      box.hidden = true;
      box.innerHTML = "";
    }
    qsa("#cardsToolbar [data-view]").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.view === state.ui.view); });
    qs("#sortSel").value = state.ui.sort;
  }

  function emptyState() {
    return '<div class="empty">' + icon("layers", 30) +
      "<p>还没有可以复习的卡<br>先到阅读页高亮几句话，闪卡会自动生成</p>" +
      '<div class="row" style="justify-content:center;margin-top:16px">' +
        '<a class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" href="index.html">' + icon("library", 15) + "去书架</a>" +
      "</div></div>";
  }
  function noMatchState() {
    return '<div class="empty">' + icon("search", 26) +
      "<p>没有匹配当前检索的卡片<br>试试去掉一些条件，或点侧栏换个维度</p>" +
      '<div class="row" style="justify-content:center;margin-top:16px">' +
        '<button class="btn btn-ghost" id="qReset">' + icon("x", 14) + "清空检索</button>" +
      "</div></div>";
  }

  /* ---------- 侧栏 ---------- */
  function totalOf(decks) { return sumBy(decks, function (d) { return d.totalN; }); }

  function sideItem(dim, token, iconName, label, count, active, title) {
    return '<button class="side-item' + (active ? " on" : "") + '" data-dim="' + esc(dim) + '" data-token="' + esc(token) + '"' +
      ' title="' + esc(title || label) + '">' +
      icon(iconName, 13) + '<span class="si-name">' + esc(label) + '</span><span class="si-n">' + count + "</span></button>";
  }

  function renderSide(res) {
    var q = state.q;
    var side = qs("#cardsSide");
    var box = [];

    /* ① 保存的检索 */
    box.push('<section class="side-sec"><div class="side-head">' + icon("star", 13) + "保存的检索</div>");
    if (!state.saved.length) {
      box.push('<p class="side-empty">还没有保存的检索。写好检索后点上方「保存检索」，下次一点即回。</p>');
    } else {
      state.saved.forEach(function (s, i) {
        box.push('<button class="side-item' + (q.trim() === s.q ? " on" : "") + '" data-saved="' + i + '" title="' + esc(s.q) + '">' +
          icon("search", 13) + '<span class="si-name">' + esc(s.name) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="si-x" data-delsaved="' + i + '" role="button" aria-label="删除检索 ' + esc(s.name) + '" title="删除">' + icon("x", 12) + "</span></button>");
      });
    }
    box.push("</section>");

    /* ② 状态（当前查询下的命中数） */
    var st = { due: 0, new: 0, sched: 0, susp: 0, excl: 0 };
    res.forEach(function (d) {
      d.cards.forEach(function (c) {
        if (c.excl) st.excl++;
        else if (c.susp) st.susp++;
        else if (c.due) st.due++;
        if (!c.susp && !c.excl && (!c.st || !c.st.reps)) st.new++;
        if (!c.susp && !c.excl && c.st && c.st.due && c.st.due > ymd()) st.sched++;
      });
    });
    box.push('<section class="side-sec"><div class="side-head">' + icon("filter", 13) + "状态</div>");
    box.push(sideItem("is", "is:due", "calendar-days", "到期", st.due, hasToken(q, "is:due"), "到期：is:due"));
    box.push(sideItem("is", "is:new", "sparkles", "新卡", st.new, hasToken(q, "is:new"), "新卡：is:new"));
    box.push(sideItem("is", "is:sched", "clock", "已排期", st.sched, hasToken(q, "is:sched"), "已排期：is:sched"));
    box.push(sideItem("is", "is:susp", "pause", "已挂起", st.susp, hasToken(q, "is:susp"), "已挂起：is:susp"));
    box.push(sideItem("is", "is:excl", "eye-off", "已排除", st.excl, hasToken(q, "is:excl"), "已排除：is:excl"));
    box.push("</section>");

    /* ③ 类别（8 类，带计数；缺的显示 0） */
    var catN = {};
    res.forEach(function (d) { catN[d.type] = (catN[d.type] || 0) + d.totalN; });
    box.push('<section class="side-sec"><div class="side-head">' + icon("layers", 13) + "类别</div>");
    CAT_ORDER.forEach(function (t) {
      box.push(sideItem("kind", "kind:" + t, catIcon(t), catName(t), catN[t] || 0, hasToken(q, "kind:" + t), catName(t) + "：kind:" + t));
    });
    box.push("</section>");

    /* ④ 文档（按书架书名，带到期数；超过 12 条给侧栏内检索） */
    box.push('<section class="side-sec"><div class="side-head">' + icon("book", 13) + "文档</div>");
    if (!res.length) {
      box.push('<p class="side-empty">当前检索下没有文档。</p>');
    } else {
      var docs = res.map(function (d) { return { docId: d.docId, name: d.name, dueN: d.dueN, totalN: d.totalN }; });
      docs.sort(function (a, b) { return b.dueN - a.dueN || String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), "zh"); });
      if (docs.length > 12) {
        box.push('<input class="side-filter" id="docFilter" type="text" placeholder="在文档中过滤…" aria-label="在文档中过滤">');
      }
      docs.forEach(function (d) {
        var token = 'doc:"' + d.name + '"';
        var active = hasToken(q, token) || hasToken(q, "doc:" + d.name);
        box.push('<button class="side-item side-doc' + (active ? " on" : "") + '" data-dim="doc" data-token="' + esc(token) + '" data-docname="' + esc(d.name) + '" title="' + esc(d.name) + ' → doc:">' +
          icon("book", 13) + '<span class="si-name">' + esc(d.name) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="si-n">到期 <b>' + d.dueN + "</b>/" + d.totalN + "</span></button>");
      });
    }
    box.push("</section>");

    side.innerHTML = box.join("");
  }

  /* ---------- 卡组：⋯ 菜单 / 卡片 / 详情 / 行 ---------- */
  function deckMenuHTML(d) {
    return '<div class="dc-menu">' +
        '<button class="dc-mi" data-rename="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' + icon("square-pen", 14) + "重命名</button>" +
        (state.confirmDel === d.docId
          ? '<button class="dc-mi danger confirm" data-del="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' + icon("alert-triangle", 14) + "确认删除（再点一次）</button>"
          : '<button class="dc-mi danger" data-del="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' + icon("trash-2", 14) + "删除卡组</button>") +
        '<p class="dc-warn">' + (state.confirmDel === d.docId
          ? "删除只清除这一组的<b>调度记录</b>，卡组随之消失；高亮与笔记不受影响。"
          : "删除 = 只删该组的调度记录；原始高亮与笔记保留，可随时重新成卡。") + "</p>" +
      "</div>";
  }
  function renameHTML(d) {
    return '<div class="dc-rename">' +
      '<input class="field" data-rename-input="' + esc(d.docId) + '" value="' + esc(d.custom ? d.name : "") + '" placeholder="' + esc(d.bookTitle) + '" aria-label="卡组名">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" data-rename-ok="' + esc(d.docId) + '">保存</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" data-rename-cancel="1">取消</button>' +
    "</div>";
  }

  function deckCardHTML(d) {
    var more = state.menu === d.docId;
    var ren = state.renaming === d.docId;
    /* 进度条 = 已排期（不在到期）比例：一眼看出这组清到什么程度 */
    var pct = d.totalN ? Math.round((d.totalN - d.dueN) / d.totalN * 100) : 0;
    var canReview = d.liveN > 0;
    return '<article class="deck-card" data-deck="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' +
      '<div class="dc-top">' +
        '<span class="chip chip-accent">' + icon(catIcon(d.type), 13) + esc(catName(d.type)) + "</span>" +
        (d.custom ? '<span class="chip">' + icon("square-pen", 12) + "自定名</span>" : "") +
        (d.suspN ? '<span class="chip chip-amber">' + icon("pause", 12) + "挂起 " + d.suspN + "</span>" : "") +
        (d.exclN ? '<span class="chip">' + icon("eye-off", 12) + "已排除 " + d.exclN + "</span>" : "") +
        '<span class="spacer"></span>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm dc-more" data-more="' + esc(d.docId) + '" title="卡组操作" aria-label="卡组操作">' + icon("ellipsis", 16) + "</button>" +
      "</div>" +
      (ren
        ? renameHTML(d)
        : '<h3 class="dc-name" data-open="' + esc(d.docId) + '" title="' + esc(d.bookTitle) + '">' + esc(d.name) + "</h3>") +
      '<p class="dc-meta">到期 <b>' + d.dueN + "</b> / 共 <b>" + d.totalN + "</b> 张" +
        (d.custom ? " · " + esc(d.bookTitle) : "") + "</p>" +
      '<div class="dc-bar"><span class="bar bar-accent"><i style="width:' + pct + '%"></i></span></div>' +
      '<div class="dc-foot">' +
        '<button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" data-review="' + esc(d.docId) + '"' + (canReview ? "" : " disabled title=\"这一组的卡都不在复习中（挂起或已排除）\"") + ">" +
          icon("play", 14) + "开始复习</button>" +
        '<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" data-open="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' +
          icon("list-tree", 14) + (isOpen(d.docId) ? "收起" : "浏览") + "</button>" +
      "</div>" +
      (more ? deckMenuHTML(d) : "") +
      "</article>";
  }

  function cardRowHTML(d, c) {
    var n = c.n, st = c.st || {};
    /* 传入 st：用户手选过的洞（cards.v1 的 cloze 字段）在这里必须照样生效，
       否则卡组看到的是机器默认挖空，与阅读页里复习到的不是同一处。 */
    var cloze = makeCloze(n.text, n.id, c.st);
    var status = c.excl ? "已排除"
      : (c.susp ? "已挂起"
        : (c.due ? "待复习" : (st.due ? "排期 " + esc(st.due) : "新卡")));
    var bits = ["P" + (n.page || 1)];
    if (st.reps) bits.push("连对 " + st.reps);
    if (st.ivl) bits.push("间隔 " + st.ivl + " 天");
    if (n.kind === "margin") bits.push("随笔");
    if (st.cloze) bits.push(st.cloze.why ? "挖「" + st.cloze.why + "」" : "自定挖空");
    else if (cloze.none) bits.push("挑不出考点");
    else if (cloze.why) bits.push("挖「" + cloze.why + "」");
    var noteTxt = bits.map(esc).join(" · ");
    return '<div class="fc-row' + (c.susp || c.excl ? " off" : "") + '" data-cid="' + esc(n.id) + '">' +
      '<div class="fc-row-main dk-main" data-flip="' + esc(n.id) + '" title="点击翻面">' +
        '<p class="dk-front" data-side="front" title="' + esc(n.text) + '">' + (cloze.none ? esc(n.text) : cloze.front) + "</p>" +
        '<p class="dk-back" data-side="back" hidden>' + esc(n.text) + "</p>" +
        '<span class="fc-row-status' + (c.due && !c.susp && !c.excl ? " due" : "") + '">' + status + "</span>" +
      "</div>" +
      '<div class="fc-row-foot">' +
        '<span class="card-note" title="' + noteTxt + '">' + noteTxt + '<span class="dk-flip-tip">　点卡片翻面</span></span>' +
        '<span class="fc-row-acts">' +
          '<button class="tool-btn" data-shift="' + esc(n.id) + '"' + (cloze.none ? " disabled title=\"这句挑不出考点，到阅读页闪卡里自己选一段\"" : " title=\"换一处挖空\"") + ">" + icon("shuffle", 12) + "换个空</button>" +
          '<button class="tool-btn" data-susp="' + esc(n.id) + '">' + (c.susp ? "恢复" : "挂起") + "</button>" +
          '<button class="tool-btn" data-excl="' + esc(n.id) + '">' + (c.excl ? "撤回排除" : "排除") + "</button>" +
          '<a class="tool-btn" href="' + esc(srcLink(d.docId, n.id)) + '" title="回到原文位置">' + icon("arrow-up-right", 14) + "原文</a>" +
        "</span>" +
      "</div>" +
      "</div>";
  }

  function deckDetailHTML(d) {
    return '<div class="deck-detail">' +
      '<div class="detail-head">' +
        '<span class="dh-k">共 ' + d.totalN + " 张 · 到期 " + d.dueN + " 张" + (d.suspN ? " · 挂起 " + d.suspN + " 张" : "") + (d.exclN ? " · 已排除 " + d.exclN + " 张" : "") + "</span>" +
        '<span class="spacer"></span>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" data-review="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' + icon("play", 14) + "开始复习</button>" +
        '<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" data-open="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' + icon("chevron-up", 14) + "收起</button>" +
      "</div>" +
      '<div class="detail-list">' + d.cards.map(function (c) { return cardRowHTML(d, c); }).join("") + "</div>" +
      '<p class="card-note" style="margin-top:10px">正面挖空 · 点卡片可看原文；挂起的卡不进复习队列；「原文」回到阅读页对应位置。</p>' +
      "</div>";
  }

  /* 紧凑列表的一行：与卡片视图同一份数据与操作（同一批 data-*，同一套事件） */
  function latestLast(d) {
    var t = "";
    d.cards.forEach(function (c) { var l = c.st && c.st.last; if (l && l > t) t = l; });
    return t || "—";
  }
  function deckRowHTML(d) {
    if (state.renaming === d.docId) {
      return '<div class="deck-row" data-deck="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' +
        '<span class="dr-cat">' + icon(catIcon(d.type), 13) + esc(catName(d.type)) + "</span>" + renameHTML(d) +
        "</div>";
    }
    var canReview = d.liveN > 0;
    return '<div class="deck-row' + (isOpen(d.docId) ? " open" : "") + '" data-deck="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' +
      '<button class="dr-namebtn" data-open="' + esc(d.docId) + '" title="浏览卡组：' + esc(d.bookTitle) + '">' +
        icon(catIcon(d.type), 14) + '<span class="dr-name">' + esc(d.name) + "</span>" +
        (d.custom ? '<span class="chip">' + icon("square-pen", 11) + "自定名</span>" : "") +
      "</button>" +
      '<span class="dr-cat">' + esc(catName(d.type)) + "</span>" +
      '<span class="dr-num">' + icon("calendar-days", 12) + "到期 <b>" + d.dueN + "</b> / " + d.totalN + "</span>" +
      '<span class="dr-recent" title="最近复习">' + icon("clock", 12) + esc(latestLast(d)) + "</span>" +
      '<span class="spacer"></span>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" data-review="' + esc(d.docId) + '"' + (canReview ? "" : " disabled title=\"这一组的卡都不在复习中（挂起或已排除）\"") + ">" + icon("play", 13) + "复习</button>" +
      '<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm dr-more" data-more="' + esc(d.docId) + '" title="卡组操作" aria-label="卡组操作">' + icon("ellipsis", 15) + "</button>" +
      (state.menu === d.docId ? deckMenuHTML(d) : "") +
      (isOpen(d.docId) ? deckDetailHTML(d) : "") +
      "</div>";
  }

  function goneStripHTML() {
    var list = goneList();
    if (!list.length) return "";
    return '<div class="gone-strip">' + icon("trash-2", 14) +
      "<span>已删除的卡组 " + list.length + " 个 · 原始高亮仍在，可随时重新成卡</span>" +
      '<span class="spacer"></span>' +
      list.map(function (g) {
        return '<button class="chip chip-btn" data-restore="' + esc(g.docId) + '" title="重新成卡">' +
          esc(g.name) + "<em>" + g.n + " 张</em></button>";
      }).join("") +
      "</div>";
  }

  /* ---------- 排序 ---------- */
  function recentOf(d) { var t = ""; d.cards.forEach(function (c) { var l = c.st && c.st.last; if (l && l > t) t = l; }); return t; }
  function byName(a, b) { return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), "zh"); }
  function sortDecks(decks) {
    var s = state.ui.sort, arr = decks.slice();
    if (s === "name") arr.sort(byName);
    else if (s === "cards") arr.sort(function (a, b) { return b.totalN - a.totalN || byName(a, b); });
    else if (s === "recent") arr.sort(function (a, b) { return (recentOf(b) < recentOf(a) ? -1 : (recentOf(b) > recentOf(a) ? 1 : 0)) || b.dueN - a.dueN || byName(a, b); });
    else arr.sort(function (a, b) { return b.dueN - a.dueN || b.totalN - a.totalN || byName(a, b); });
    return arr;
  }

  /* 卡片视图：按类别分组陈列（组间按类别序，组内按当前排序） */
  function renderGrid(decks) {
    var groups = [];
    decks.forEach(function (d) {
      var g = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) if (groups[i].type === d.type) { g = groups[i]; break; }
      if (!g) { g = { type: d.type, decks: [] }; groups.push(g); }
      g.decks.push(d);
    });
    groups.forEach(function (g) { g.decks = sortDecks(g.decks); });
    groups.sort(function (a, b) { return catRank(a.type) - catRank(b.type) || String(a.type).localeCompare(String(b.type)); });
    return groups.map(function (g) {
      return '<section class="cat-block" data-cat="' + esc(g.type) + '">' +
        '<div class="cat-head">' + icon(catIcon(g.type), 16) + "<h2>" + esc(catName(g.type)) + "</h2>" +
          '<span class="cat-n">' + g.decks.length + " 组 · " +
            g.decks.reduce(function (s, d) { return s + d.totalN; }, 0) + " 张</span>" +
          '<span class="cat-rule"></span>' +
        "</div>" +
        '<div class="deck-grid">' + g.decks.map(function (d) {
          return '<div class="deck-item' + (isOpen(d.docId) ? " open" : "") + '" data-deck="' + esc(d.docId) + '">' +
            deckCardHTML(d) + (isOpen(d.docId) ? deckDetailHTML(d) : "") + "</div>";
        }).join("") + "</div>" +
        "</section>";
    }).join("");
  }

  /* 紧凑列表视图：一行一卡组（名称·类别·到期/总·最近复习·操作） */
  function renderList(decks) {
    return '<div class="deck-list">' + sortDecks(decks).map(deckRowHTML).join("") + "</div>";
  }

  function renderBody(res) {
    var box = qs("#cardsBody");
    var gone = goneStripHTML();
    if (!state.allCount) { box.innerHTML = gone + emptyState(); return; }
    if (!res.length) { box.innerHTML = gone + noMatchState(); return; }
    var inner = state.ui.view === "list" ? renderList(res) : renderGrid(res);
    box.innerHTML = inner + gone;
    if (state.renaming) {
      var inp = qs('[data-rename-input="' + CSS.escape(state.renaming) + '"]');
      if (inp) { inp.focus(); inp.select(); }
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     七、卡组操作：重命名 / 删除（两击确认）/ 挂起
     ============================================================ */
  function findDeck(docId) {
    var hit = null;
    buildDecks().forEach(function (d) { if (d.docId === docId) hit = d; });
    return hit;
  }

  function saveRename(docId, value) {
    var name = String(value || "").trim().slice(0, 40);
    /* 空名 = 恢复书名（删掉自定名这条），不是把卡组叫「」 */
    if (name) state.decks[docId] = name; else delete state.decks[docId];
    writeDecks(state.decks);
    state.renaming = null;
    render();
    toast(name ? "已重命名为「" + name + "」· 已本地保存" : "已恢复书名", "square-pen");
  }

  /* 删除卡组：只删该组所有卡的调度记录（cards.v1 对应 key）+ 自定名，
     原始高亮与笔记一律保留；加一条墓碑让该组不再自动重新成卡（可一键恢复）。 */
  function dropDeck(docId) {
    var d = findDeck(docId);
    if (!d) return;
    var n = 0;
    d.cards.forEach(function (c) { if (state.cards[c.n.id]) { delete state.cards[c.n.id]; n++; } });
    writeCardsAll(state.cards);
    if (state.decks[docId]) { delete state.decks[docId]; writeDecks(state.decks); }
    /* 墓碑顺手记下书名：文档删了以后，这一组仍叫得出自己原来是谁（老墓碑没这个字段，走占位文案） */
    state.gone[docId] = { at: stamp(), n: d.totalN, t: d.bookTitle };
    writeGone(state.gone);
    state.menu = null; state.confirmDel = null;
    var oi = state.ui.openDecks.indexOf(docId);
    if (oi >= 0) { state.ui.openDecks.splice(oi, 1); writeUI(); }
    render();
    toast("已删除「" + d.name + "」的调度记录（" + n + " 条）· 高亮与笔记不受影响", "trash-2");
  }

  /* 重新成卡：摘掉墓碑，该文档的高亮立刻按「新卡」重新成组 */
  function restoreDeck(docId) {
    delete state.gone[docId];
    writeGone(state.gone);
    render();
    toast("已重新成卡 · 全部按新卡从头开始排期", "layers");
  }

  function toggleSusp(noteId) {
    var cur = state.cards[noteId] || {};
    var next = Object.assign({}, cur);
    if (next.suspended) delete next.suspended; else next.suspended = true;
    state.cards[noteId] = next;
    API.saveCard(noteId, next);
    render();
    toast(next.suspended ? "已挂起，复习队列跳过这张卡" : "已恢复进入复习队列", "layers");
  }

  /* 「排除」与「挂起」分列：挂起＝这轮先放着（仍算一张卡）；
     排除＝这条高亮本不该成卡（不进队列、不计到期），但卡组里始终可见、随时撤回。
     都不动原始高亮 —— 删笔记是另一回事。 */
  function toggleExcl(noteId) {
    var cur = state.cards[noteId] || {};
    var next = Object.assign({}, cur);
    if (next.excluded) delete next.excluded; else next.excluded = true;
    state.cards[noteId] = next;
    API.saveCard(noteId, next);
    render();
    toast(next.excluded ? "已排掉这张卡，不再进入复习队列" : "已撤回排除，重新进入复习队列", "eye-off");
  }

  function findCard(noteId) {
    var hit = null;
    buildDecks().forEach(function (d) {
      d.cards.forEach(function (c) { if (!hit && c.n.id === noteId) hit = c; });
    });
    return hit;
  }

  /* 换个空：机器把候选按分数排好，这里循环取下一处 —— 出题权在人，
     但不必从空白手填。选中的位置写进 cards.v1 的 cloze 字段，永久覆盖机器默认。 */
  function shiftCloze(noteId) {
    var c = findCard(noteId);
    if (!c) return;
    var nx = InkSRS.nextCloze(c.n.text, InkSRS.clozeFor(c.n, c.st));
    if (!nx) { toast("这一句只有这一处可挖", "info"); return; }
    var next = Object.assign({}, state.cards[noteId] || {}, { cloze: { at: nx.at, len: nx.len, why: nx.why } });
    state.cards[noteId] = next;
    API.saveCard(noteId, next);
    render();
    toast("已换到「" + nx.why + "」处挖空", "shuffle");
  }

  /* ============================================================
     八、复习流（页内全屏浮层）—— v2.10 未改动
     队列 = 该组非挂起卡里的到期卡；无到期则全部（提前复习），与阅读页同口径。
     ============================================================ */
  function deckQueue(d) {
    var active = d.cards.filter(function (c) { return !c.susp && !c.excl; });
    if (!active.length) return { list: [], ahead: false };
    var due = active.filter(function (c) { return c.due; });
    if (!due.length) return { list: active, ahead: true };
    return { list: due, ahead: false };
  }

  function startReview(docId) {
    var d = findDeck(docId);
    if (!d) return;
    var q = deckQueue(d);
    if (!q.list.length) { toast("这一组的卡都不在复习中 · 到详情里恢复或撤回排除", "pause"); return; }
    state.rv = { docId: docId, name: d.name, list: q.list, idx: 0, flipped: false, done: false, ahead: q.ahead, reviewed: 0 };
    qs("#fcStage").hidden = false;
    renderReview();
  }

  function exitReview() {
    qs("#fcStage").hidden = true;
    state.rv = null;
    render();          /* 回列表：到期数 / 排期已变 */
  }

  function flipReview() {
    var rv = state.rv;
    if (!rv || rv.done) return;
    rv.flipped = !rv.flipped;
    renderReview();
  }

  function renderReview() {
    var rv = state.rv, body = qs("#fcsBody");
    qs("#fcsName").textContent = rv.name;
    if (rv.done) { renderSummary(body, rv); return; }
    var c = rv.list[rv.idx];
    var st = state.cards[c.n.id] || null;
    var n = c.n;
    qs("#fcsProg").textContent = (rv.idx + 1) + " / " + rv.list.length;
    /* 卡头信息：本组还到期多少 / 共多少（与阅读页 fc-due 同一口径） */
    var d = findDeck(rv.docId);
    var rvCloze = makeCloze(n.text, n.id, st);
    var head = d
      ? (rv.ahead
          ? icon("circle-check", 12) + " 这一组今天已清空 · 提前复习 " + rv.list.length + " 张"
          : icon("calendar-days", 12) + " 到期 <b>" + d.dueN + "</b> 张 · 本组共 " + (d.totalN - d.exclN) + " 张")
      : "";
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div class="fc-due">' + head +
        (st && st.last ? '<span class="spacer"></span>上次 ' + esc(st.last) + " · 间隔 " + esc(st.ivl) + " 天" : "") +
      "</div>" +
      '<div class="fc-meta"><span>P' + esc(n.page || 1) + " · " + esc(n.at || "本机笔记") + "</span>" +
        (rvCloze.none ? '<span class="fc-why">挑不出考点</span>' : '<span class="fc-why">' + esc(rvCloze.why || "自定") + "</span>") +
        '<span class="spacer"></span><b>' + (rv.idx + 1) + " / " + rv.list.length + "</b></div>" +
      '<div class="fc-card" id="fcCard" data-flip="' + (rv.flipped ? "on" : "off") + '" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="点击卡片看答案">' +
        '<div class="fc-side fc-front">' +
          '<span class="fc-tag">挖空</span>' +
          '<p' + (rvCloze.none ? ' class="fc-nocand"' : "") + ">" + (rvCloze.none ? esc(n.text) : rvCloze.front) + "</p>" +
          '<span class="fc-tip">' + (rvCloze.none ? "这句没挑出考点，直接读一遍即可 · 也可到卡组里换个空" : "点击卡片看答案") + "</span>" +
        "</div>" +
        '<div class="fc-side fc-back">' +
          '<span class="fc-tag">原文</span>' +
          "<p>" + esc(n.text) + "</p>" +
          '<span class="fc-tip">' + (n.kind === "margin" ? "随笔" : "高亮") + " · P" + esc(n.page || 1) + "</span>" +
        "</div>" +
      "</div>" +
      '<div class="fc-rate" id="fcRate"' + (rv.flipped ? "" : " hidden") + ">" +
        RATE.map(function (r) {
          return '<button class="fc-rate-btn" data-q="' + r[0] + '">' + esc(r[1]) + "<em>" + esc(r[2]) + "</em></button>";
        }).join("") +
      "</div>" +
      '<p class="fcs-key"><kbd>空格</kbd>翻面 · <kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>4</kbd>评分 · <kbd>Esc</kbd>退出</p>';
  }

  function renderSummary(body, rv) {
    qs("#fcsProg").textContent = rv.reviewed + " / " + rv.list.length;
    var d = findDeck(rv.docId);
    var nextN = 0, near = null;
    if (d) {
      d.cards.forEach(function (c) {
        var st = c.st || {};
        if (st.due && st.due > ymd()) {
          nextN++;
          if (!near || st.due < near) near = st.due;
        }
      });
    }
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div class="fcs-sum">' + icon("circle-check", 34) +
        '<p class="big">复习 ' + rv.reviewed + " 张 · 下次到期 " + nextN + " 张</p>" +
        '<p class="card-note">' + (near ? "最近一次：" + esc(near) + " · " + nextN + " 张排队中" : "本组暂无排期中的卡") +
          "<br>间隔按遗忘曲线自动排期（SM-2），已写入本机复习进度。</p>" +
        '<div class="row" style="justify-content:center;margin-top:18px">' +
          '<button class="btn btn-accent" id="fcsAgain">再复习一轮</button>' +
          '<button class="btn btn-ghost" id="fcsBack">回到卡组</button>' +
        "</div>" +
      "</div>";
  }

  /* 评分：sm2Update 结算 → 落 inkread.cards.v1（经 API.saveCard，与阅读页同一通路）→ 下一张 */
  function rateCard(q) {
    var rv = state.rv;
    if (!rv || rv.done || !rv.flipped) return;
    var c = rv.list[rv.idx];
    var next = sm2Update(q, state.cards[c.n.id]);
    state.cards[c.n.id] = next;
    API.saveCard(c.n.id, next);
    rv.reviewed++;
    rv.idx++;
    rv.flipped = false;
    if (rv.idx >= rv.list.length) rv.done = true;
    renderReview();
    InkFX.flash();
    toast("已排期：" + next.due + "（间隔 " + next.ivl + " 天）", "calendar-days");
  }

  /* ============================================================
     九、事件（委托在容器上：每次重渲染后无需重绑）
     ============================================================ */
  qs("#cardsBody").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest("#qReset")) { state.q = ""; syncQInput(); render(); return; }
    var t = e.target;
    var more = t.closest("[data-more]");
    if (more) {
      state.menu = state.menu === more.dataset.more ? null : more.dataset.more;
      state.confirmDel = null;
      render();
      return;
    }
    var ren = t.closest("[data-rename]");
    if (ren) { state.renaming = ren.dataset.rename; state.menu = null; state.confirmDel = null; render(); return; }
    var rk = t.closest("[data-rename-ok]");
    if (rk) {
      var input = document.querySelector('[data-rename-input="' + CSS.escape(rk.dataset.renameOk) + '"]');
      saveRename(rk.dataset.renameOk, input ? input.value : "");
      return;
    }
    if (t.closest("[data-rename-cancel]")) { state.renaming = null; render(); return; }
    var del = t.closest("[data-del]");
    if (del) {
      if (state.confirmDel === del.dataset.del) { dropDeck(del.dataset.del); return; }
      state.confirmDel = del.dataset.del;      /* 第一击：换成确认态，第二击才删 */
      render();
      return;
    }
    var rev = t.closest("[data-review]");
    if (rev) { startReview(rev.dataset.review); return; }
    var rs = t.closest("[data-restore]");
    if (rs) { restoreDeck(rs.dataset.restore); return; }
    var op = t.closest("[data-open]");
    if (op) {
      toggleOpen(op.dataset.open);
      state.menu = null; state.confirmDel = null;
      render();
      return;
    }
    var sp = t.closest("[data-susp]");
    if (sp) { toggleSusp(sp.dataset.susp); return; }
    var ex = t.closest("[data-excl]");
    if (ex) { toggleExcl(ex.dataset.excl); return; }
    var sh = t.closest("[data-shift]");
    if (sh && !sh.disabled) { shiftCloze(sh.dataset.shift); return; }
    var fl = t.closest("[data-flip]");
    if (fl) {                                  /* 行内翻面：正面（挖空）⇄ 背面（原文） */
      var front = fl.querySelector('[data-side="front"]');
      var back = fl.querySelector('[data-side="back"]');
      var toBack = !back.hidden;
      back.hidden = toBack;
      front.hidden = !toBack;
      return;
    }
  });
  /* 重命名输入：回车保存 */
  qs("#cardsBody").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    var inp = e.target.closest("[data-rename-input]");
    if (!inp) return;
    if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); saveRename(inp.dataset.renameInput, inp.value); }
    else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); state.renaming = null; render(); }
  });
  /* 失焦（点到重命名行之外）也保存，不留半开状态 */
  qs("#cardsBody").addEventListener("focusout", function (e) {
    var inp = e.target.closest("[data-rename-input]");
    if (!inp || !state.renaming) return;
    var box = inp.closest(".dc-rename");
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (box && box.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
      if (state.renaming === inp.dataset.renameInput) saveRename(inp.dataset.renameInput, inp.value);
    }, 120);
  });
  /* 点空白处收起 ⋯ 菜单（第一击确认态一并复位） */
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (!state.menu) return;
    if (e.target.closest(".dc-menu") || e.target.closest("[data-more]")) return;
    state.menu = null; state.confirmDel = null;
    render();
  });

  /* ---------- 工具条：检索 / 视图 / 排序 / 保存检索 / 侧栏折叠 ---------- */
  qs("#q").addEventListener("input", function () { state.q = this.value; render(); });
  qs("#qClear").addEventListener("click", function () { state.q = ""; syncQInput(); qs("#q").focus(); render(); });
  qsa("#cardsToolbar [data-view]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (state.ui.view === b.dataset.view) return;
      state.ui.view = b.dataset.view;
      writeUI();
      render();
    });
  });
  qs("#sortSel").addEventListener("change", function () { state.ui.sort = this.value; writeUI(); render(); });
  qs("#saveQ").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var box = qs("#saveBox");
    box.hidden = false;
    var inp = qs("#saveName");
    inp.value = (state.q || "").trim().slice(0, 40);
    inp.focus(); inp.select();
  });
  qs("#saveCancel").addEventListener("click", function () { qs("#saveBox").hidden = true; });
  function commitSave() {
    var q = (state.q || "").trim();
    if (!q) { qs("#saveBox").hidden = true; toast("检索为空，无需保存", "search"); return; }
    var name = (qs("#saveName").value || "").trim().slice(0, 40) || q;
    state.saved.unshift({ name: name, q: q, at: stamp() });
    if (state.saved.length > 20) state.saved = state.saved.slice(0, 20);   /* 先进先出 */
    writeSaved(state.saved);
    qs("#saveBox").hidden = true;
    renderSide(state.res);
    toast("已保存检索「" + name + "」", "star");
  }
  qs("#saveOk").addEventListener("click", commitSave);
  qs("#saveName").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); commitSave(); }
    else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); qs("#saveBox").hidden = true; }
  });
  qs("#sideToggle").addEventListener("click", function () {
    state.ui.side = !state.ui.side;
    writeUI();
    qs("#cardsMain").classList.toggle("side-off", !state.ui.side);
  });

  /* ---------- 侧栏：快捷输入（点击 / Ctrl / Shift / Alt） ---------- */
  qs("#cardsSide").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var del = e.target.closest("[data-delsaved]");
    if (del) {
      state.saved.splice(+del.dataset.delsaved, 1);
      writeSaved(state.saved);
      renderSide(state.res);
      return;
    }
    var sv = e.target.closest("[data-saved]");
    if (sv) {
      var item = state.saved[+sv.dataset.saved];
      if (item) { state.q = item.q; syncQInput(); render(); }
      return;
    }
    var it = e.target.closest("[data-dim]");
    if (it) {
      var mode = (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) ? "ctrl" : (e.shiftKey ? "shift" : (e.altKey ? "alt" : "click"));
      applySide(it.dataset.dim, it.dataset.token, mode);
    }
  });
  /* 文档过多时的侧栏内过滤：只切显示，不重排（保住输入焦点） */
  qs("#cardsSide").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest("#docFilter")) return;
    var v = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    qsa("#cardsSide .side-doc").forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.display = (!v || String(el.dataset.docname || "").toLowerCase().indexOf(v) >= 0) ? "" : "none";
    });
  });

  /* ---------- 复习浮层内的事件 ---------- */
  qs("#fcStage").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest("#fcsExit") || e.target.closest("#fcsBack")) { exitReview(); return; }
    if (e.target.closest("#fcsAgain")) {
      if (!state.rv) return;
      var id = state.rv.docId; state.rv = null;
      startReview(id);
      return;
    }
    var q = e.target.closest("[data-q]");
    if (q) { rateCard(+q.dataset.q); return; }
    if (e.target.closest("#fcCard")) { flipReview(); }
  });
  /* 键盘：空格翻面、1–4 评分、Esc 退出（v2.22 S5：动作键入 InkKeys 注册表，
     when 门控 = 原首行守卫；inInput:true 保持「复习层内无输入域豁免」原语义）。
     Esc 留局部。 */
  if (window.InkKeys) {
    var rvOpen = function () { return !!state.rv && !qs("#fcStage").hidden; };
    InkKeys.on("space", function () { flipReview(); }, { when: rvOpen, inInput: true, title: "翻面", group: "复习" });
    ["1", "2", "3", "4"].forEach(function (d) {
      InkKeys.on(d, function () { rateCard(+RATE[+d - 1][0]); }, { when: rvOpen, inInput: true, title: "评分 · " + RATE[+d - 1][1], group: "复习" });
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (!state.rv || qs("#fcStage").hidden) return;
    if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); exitReview(); return; }
  });
  qs("#icExit").innerHTML = icon("chevron-left", 14);

  /* 从别的页面回来（切回本页 / 书架改了笔记）时重读一次：状态不保鲜 */
  window.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    if (state.rv) return;
    load();
  });

  /* ---------- 工具条静态控件的图标与选项（HTML 保持无脚本也可读的语义标签） ---------- */
  qs("#icQ").innerHTML = icon("search", 15);
  qs("#qClear").innerHTML = icon("x", 14);
  qsa("#cardsToolbar [data-view]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.innerHTML = icon(b.dataset.view === "grid" ? "grid-2x2" : "list", 14) + (b.dataset.view === "grid" ? "卡片" : "列表");
  });
  qs("#sortSel").innerHTML = [["due", "到期优先"], ["name", "名称"], ["cards", "卡数"], ["recent", "最近复习"]].map(function (o) {
    return '<option value="' + o[0] + '">' + o[1] + "</option>";
  }).join("");
  qs("#saveQ").innerHTML = icon("star", 14) + "保存检索";
  qs("#sideToggle").innerHTML = icon("panel-right", 15);
  qs("#cardsMain").classList.toggle("side-off", !state.ui.side);
  qs("#q").value = state.q;

  /* ============================================================
     十、启动
     ============================================================ */
  function load() {
    state.decks = readDecks();
    state.gone = readGone();
    /* 顺手清掉「墓碑还在、笔记和文档都没了」的残留，别让恢复条无限长大 */
    var aliveNotes = {};
    cardSources(InkStore.getNotes() || []).forEach(function (n) { aliveNotes[n.docId || ""] = 1; });
    var pruned = false;
    Object.keys(state.gone).forEach(function (docId) {
      if (!aliveNotes[docId]) { delete state.gone[docId]; pruned = true; }
    });
    if (pruned) writeGone(state.gone);
    return API.fetchCards().then(function (r) {
      state.cards = (r && r.data) || {};
      render();
    }).catch(function () { state.cards = {}; render(); });
  }
  load();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
````

<script>
(function () {
  var state = { scope: "daily", onlyUndone: true, focus: false };
  var ck = InkStore.getCheckins();

  var IC = { icSrc: "book-open", icBatch: "sun", icToday: "calendar-days", icBatchTitle: "sun" };
  Object.keys(IC).forEach(function (id) { var el = qs("#" + id); if (el) el.innerHTML = icon(IC[id], 16); });
  qs("#batchX").innerHTML = icon("x", 18);

  /* 任务来源：本机导入任务 + 分配覆盖的合并视图（API.localTasks），
     导入文档确认后生成的任务在这里立即可见。v2.22 起演示任务不再常驻。 */
  var TASKS = (window.API && API.localTasks) ? API.localTasks() : DB.tasks.slice();
  var daily = TASKS.filter(function (t) { return t.kind === "daily"; });
  var monthly = TASKS.filter(function (t) { return t.kind === "monthly"; });

  /* 页头「查看原文」指向第一条任务的来源文档（v2.22 台账 5：原为死链 plan-01）；
     没有来源文档（无任务 / 手记任务）时单独隐藏这颗钮 —— 留着就是指向 # 的死链，
     整组页头操作在零任务时另由 renderZero 收起。 */
  if (TASKS.length && TASKS[0].docId) {
    qs("#srcLink").href = "reader.html?doc=" + encodeURIComponent(TASKS[0].docId);
  } else {
    qs("#srcLink").style.display = "none";
  }

  /* 批量分配弹窗里的范围选项：条数按合并后的真实清单给出 */
  qsa("#batchScope option").forEach(function (o) {
    var n = o.value === "daily" ? daily.length : o.value === "monthly" ? monthly.length : TASKS.length;
    o.textContent = o.textContent.replace(/（.*）/, "（" + n + " 项）");
  });

  function done(id) { return !!ck[id]; }

  function taskCard(t, inTimeline) {
    var on = done(t.id);
    /* 既无日期也无月份的条目（月度清单里的「未标注月份」组）不出徽标：
       84px 描边盒子空着就是一道视觉噪声，正文自己会顶到左边。 */
    var when = t.time || t.monthLabel || "", sub = t.week || t.phase || "";
    var badge = (when || sub)
      ? '<div class="task-time">' + esc(when) + '<br><span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-3)">' + esc(sub) + "</span></div>"
      : "";
    var card =
      '<div class="task-card' + (on ? " done" : "") + '" id="' + t.id + '">' +
        badge +
        '<div class="task-body">' +
          '<div class="task-title">' + esc(t.title) + "</div>" +
          '<div class="task-quote">' + esc(t.quote) +
            (t.anchor ? '　<a href="reader.html?doc=' + t.docId + "#" + t.anchor + '">查看原文 ›</a>' : "") +
          "</div>" +
          '<div class="task-meta">' +
            '<span class="chip">' + icon("layers", 12) + esc(t.src) + "</span>" +
            (t.today ? '<span class="chip chip-accent">' + icon("sun", 12) + "今日</span>" : "") +
            (on ? '<span class="chip chip-green">' + icon("circle-check", 12) + "已打卡 " + esc(ck[t.id]) + "</span>"
                : '<span class="chip chip-amber">' + icon("clock", 12) + "待完成</span>") +
          "</div>" +
        "</div>" +
        '<div class="task-side">' +
          '<button class="chip chip-btn' + (t.today ? " on" : "") + '" data-today="' + t.id + '"' +
            ' aria-pressed="' + (t.today ? "true" : "false") + '" title="在「今日聚焦」里只看这条任务">' +
            icon("sun", 12) + (t.today ? "已在今日" : "加入今日") + "</button>" +
          (on
            ? '<span class="stamp">已打卡</span><button class="undo-link" data-undo="' + t.id + '">撤销打卡</button>'
            : '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-accent" data-check="' + t.id + '">' + icon("stamp", 14) + "打卡</button>") +
        "</div>" +
      "</div>";
    return inTimeline ? '<div class="tl-item' + (on ? " done" : "") + (t.today ? " now" : "") + '">' + card + "</div>" : card;
  }

  function focusEmpty() {
    return '<p class="card-note" style="padding:18px 4px">今日聚焦里还没有任务 —— 点任务右侧的「加入今日」，把今天要先做完的挑进来。</p>';
  }

  function renderDaily() {
    var list = state.focus ? daily.filter(function (t) { return t.today; }) : daily;
    if (!list.length) { qs("#dailyWrap").innerHTML = focusEmpty(); return; }
    qs("#dailyWrap").innerHTML = '<div class="day-timeline">' + list.map(function (t) { return taskCard(t, true); }).join("") + "</div>";
  }

  function renderMonthly() {
    /* v2.22：月份分组从任务自身派生（此前读 DB.months 演示数据 —— 导入任务
       即使带月份字段也永远不显示）。空月份不再预置。 */
    var order = [], byKey = {};
    monthly.forEach(function (t) {
      var k = t.month || "misc";
      /* 无月份字段的任务聚到内部键 misc —— 组头给人话，不把键名晾在界面上。 */
      if (!byKey[k]) { byKey[k] = { key: k, label: t.monthLabel || (k === "misc" ? "未标注月份" : k), phase: t.phase || "", list: [] }; order.push(byKey[k]); }
      byKey[k].list.push(t);
    });
    order.sort(function (a, b) { return String(a.key).localeCompare(String(b.key), "zh-Hans-CN"); });
    var out = order.map(function (m) {
      var list = state.focus ? m.list.filter(function (t) { return t.today; }) : m.list;
      if (state.focus && !list.length) return "";
      var dn = list.filter(function (t) { return done(t.id); }).length;
      var pct = list.length ? Math.round(dn / list.length * 100) : 0;
      return '<div class="month-block">' +
        '<div class="month-head"><h3>' + esc(m.label) + (m.phase ? " · " + esc(m.phase) : "") + "</h3>" +
          '<span class="bar mh-bar"><i style="width:' + pct + '%"></i></span>' +
          '<span class="mh-pct">' + dn + "/" + list.length + "</span></div>" +
        list.map(function (t) { return taskCard(t, false); }).join("") +
        "</div>";
    }).join("");
    qs("#monthlyWrap").innerHTML = out || (state.focus ? focusEmpty()
      : '<p class="card-note" style="padding:18px 4px">还没有月度任务 —— 导入带月度计划的文档后，任务会按月份分组出现在这里。</p>');
  }

  function renderHead() {
    var dn = daily.filter(function (t) { return done(t.id); }).length;
    var ring = qs("#dayRing");
    ring.style.setProperty("--p", daily.length ? Math.round(dn / daily.length * 100) : 0);
    /* v2.17：环上原来写「0%」，与右侧「今日完成 0/5」和下面那句「已完成 0 / 5 项」
       是同一个数的三次表达。环的弧长本身就表示百分比，环心改写成 0/5 这个分数，
       于是「今日」这一维只剩一处读数，另两处删掉。
       v2.22：无每日任务时给「—」占位，不留 0/0。 */
    ring.querySelector("i").textContent = daily.length ? dn + "/" + daily.length : "—";
    var d = new Date();
    var wk = ["日", "一", "二", "三", "四", "五", "六"][d.getDay()];
    qs("#dayNote").innerHTML = d.getFullYear() + " 年 " + (d.getMonth() + 1) + " 月 " + d.getDate() + " 日 · 周" + wk +
      "<br>共 " + TASKS.length + " 项任务 · 由导入文档逐条解析";
    var mAll = monthly.length, mDone = monthly.filter(function (t) { return done(t.id); }).length;
    var total = TASKS.length, tDone = TASKS.filter(function (t) { return done(t.id); }).length;
    /* 连续打卡没有日期维度，按「今天有打卡 = 1 天，否则 0 天」的保守口径 */
    var hasCheckin = Object.keys(ck || {}).length > 0;
    /* v2.22：分母为 0 的读数给「—」占位 —— 此前 0/0 会算出 NaN% 直接上屏 */
    qs("#dayStats").innerHTML = [
      { k: "月度完成", v: mAll ? mDone + "/" + mAll : "—", i: "calendar-days" },
      { k: "总完成率", v: total ? Math.round(tDone / total * 100) + "%" : "—", i: "target" },
      { k: "连续打卡", v: (hasCheckin ? 1 : 0) + " 天", i: "flame" }
    ].map(function (c) {
      return '<div class="chip" style="padding:7px 13px">' + icon(c.i, 14) + c.k + "　<b>" + c.v + "</b></div>";
    }).join("");
    qs("#scopeNote").textContent = (state.focus ? "今日聚焦 · 只显示标了「今日」的任务" :
      state.scope === "daily" ? "每日任务 · 由导入文档逐条解析"
                              : "月度任务 · 按计划月份分组");
    qs("#tasksSub").textContent = TASKS.length
      ? "共 " + TASKS.length + " 项任务 · 打卡与今日标记本地保存"
      : "导入计划文档后，任务在这里自动生成";
  }

  /* v2.22 三态：0 任务时整卡换成空态（环形 / 分段器 / 批量设置都没有可作用的对象），
     页头操作一并收起；引导指向真实存在的两条路：导入解析、阅读页任务抽屉。 */
  function renderZero() {
    var zero = !TASKS.length;
    qs("#headCard").style.display = zero ? "none" : "";
    qs("#zeroWrap").style.display = zero ? "" : "none";
    qs("#phActions").style.display = zero ? "none" : "";
    if (zero && !qs("#zeroBox").innerHTML) {
      qs("#zeroBox").innerHTML = icon("clipboard-check", 30) +
        "<p>还没有任务<br>导入一份计划 / 备考文档，墨读会逐条解析成可打卡的任务；<br>打开文档后，阅读页右下角的任务抽屉可随时勾画</p>" +
        '<a class="btn btn-primary" href="index.html" style="margin-top:14px">去导入文档</a>';
    }
  }

  function renderAll() { renderZero(); renderHead(); renderDaily(); renderMonthly(); }

  /* 打卡 / 撤销 / 分配 */
  document.addEventListener("click", async function (e) {
    var c = e.target.closest("[data-check]");
    var u = e.target.closest("[data-undo]");
    if (c) {
      var id = c.dataset.check;
      c.disabled = true;
      var r = await API.checkin(id);
      ck = InkStore.getCheckins();
      InkFX.flash();
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("ink:checkins"));   /* 侧栏 streak 卡即时重画 */
      renderAll();
      var el = qs("#" + id);
      if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" }); }
      /* stored=false：打卡没落盘（配额满/禁写），重读后界面会回到未打卡态 —— 如实说明 */
      if (r && r.data && r.data.stored === false) toast("打卡没能保存：本机存储写不进去（空间已满或被禁用）", "alert-triangle");
      else toast("已打卡 " + r.data.time + " · 已本地保存", "stamp");
    } else if (u) {
      await API.undoCheckin(u.dataset.undo);
      ck = InkStore.getCheckins();
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("ink:checkins"));
      renderAll();
      toast("已撤销打卡", "undo-2");
    }
  });

  /* 「加入今日」落库（inkread.tasks.v1 的 today 标记）后同步本会话副本，界面即时反映。
     替代原先的「负责人」下拉：那三个名字是 mock.js 里的演示人物，指派给谁都不会
     触发任何行为，而真实导入的任务还会被默认写成第一个假名字。 */
  function applyLocalToday(id, on) {
    TASKS.forEach(function (t) { if (t.id === id) t.today = on; });
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", async function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("[data-today]");
    if (!b) return;
    var id = b.dataset.today;
    var on = !(TASKS.find(function (t) { return t.id === id; }) || {}).today;
    b.disabled = true;
    await API.setToday(id, on);
    applyLocalToday(id, on);
    renderAll();
    toast(on ? "已加入今日聚焦" : "已移出今日聚焦", "sun");
  });

  /* 范围切换 */
  qsa("#scopeSeg .seg-btn").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      qsa("#scopeSeg .seg-btn").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); });
      b.classList.add("on");
      state.scope = b.dataset.scope;
      qs("#dailyWrap").style.display = state.scope === "daily" ? "block" : "none";
      qs("#monthlyWrap").style.display = state.scope === "monthly" ? "block" : "none";
      renderHead();
    });
  });

  qs("#focusChip").addEventListener("click", function () {
    state.focus = !state.focus;
    qs("#focusChip").classList.toggle("on", state.focus);
    qs("#focusChip").setAttribute("aria-pressed", state.focus ? "true" : "false");
    renderAll();
  });

  /* 批量分配 */
  var mask = qs("#batchMask");
  qs("#btnBatch").addEventListener("click", function () { mask.style.display = "grid"; });
  qs("#batchX").addEventListener("click", function () { mask.style.display = "none"; });
  qs("#batchCancel").addEventListener("click", function () { mask.style.display = "none"; });
  mask.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === mask) mask.style.display = "none"; });
  /* Esc 关闭批量分配弹窗（与 index.html 导入弹窗同一套约定） */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key !== "Escape" || mask.style.display !== "grid") return;
    mask.style.display = "none";
  });
  qs("#onlyUndone").addEventListener("click", function () {
    state.onlyUndone = true;
    qs("#onlyUndone").classList.add("on"); qs("#allTasks").classList.remove("on");
  });
  qs("#allTasks").addEventListener("click", function () {
    state.onlyUndone = false;
    qs("#allTasks").classList.add("on"); qs("#onlyUndone").classList.remove("on");
  });
  qs("#batchConfirm").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    var scope = qs("#batchScope").value, on = qs("#batchWho").value === "today";
    var list = TASKS.filter(function (t) {
      if (scope === "daily" && t.kind !== "daily") return false;
      if (scope === "monthly" && t.kind !== "monthly") return false;
      if (state.onlyUndone && done(t.id)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      await API.setToday(list[i].id, on);
      applyLocalToday(list[i].id, on);
    }
    mask.style.display = "none";
    renderAll();
    toast((on ? "已将 " : "已移出 ") + list.length + " 项" + (on ? "加入今日聚焦" : "今日聚焦"), "sun");
  });

  renderAll();

  if (location.hash) {
    setTimeout(function () {
      var el = qs("#" + CSS.escape(location.hash.slice(1)));
      if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" }); el.classList.add("flash"); setTimeout(function () { el.classList.remove("flash"); }, 1900); }
    }, 160);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
````
